~Artificer~.Effect:
Spending {Gold}Gold for its components, design and assemble a mechanized apparatus capable of performing simple, repetitive operations such as illumination, sound emission, olfactory diffusion, or the projection of pigment to form crude symbols or imagery.
You can create any normal weapon, armor, non-food general good or adventuring gear item piece by spending its {Gold}Gold cost.
You can _dismantle_ any good into {Gold}Gold equal to its selling worth.
~Artificer~.Notes: You can't use them to deal Damage, crowd control or heal. Typically, items sell at 25% of their base cost, and magic items at 50% of their base cost. Feel free to be creative with what you can do - the tools might do other small artificer tasks as well. Ask your QM! The spent {Gold}Gold for this is used as resource for obtaining or transmuting materials.

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, manually add +1 to a Stat of choice. Go to My Character and click on the number you want to add or subtract from.

~Better Faster Stronger~.Effect:
You start with +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +3).

You have both a set of Minor and Keystone Talents at Level 1. All your other Talents are Keystone Talents.
Instead of picking extra Minor Talents due to your Intelligence, you can pick extra Keystone Talents (but only for Talents up to and including Level 5 Talents).
~Better Faster Stronger~.Upgrade:
_Optimization through augmentation:_ the governing axiom of all Artificers. Every enhancement demands equivalence; every ascension a sacrifice. How much of your humanity will you surrender in pursuit of God?
Many Artificer Talents are conversions of your Sense into long-term, structural refinements, some of which can be gained over and over.
~Better Faster Stronger~.Notes: For Keystone Talents Level 6 and above, you can only pick 1 of each.

<Grenade>.Effect:
Create a grenade with one of the effects below.
Each effect has a different area size (centered on the grenade).
You can have up to 3 grenades created at a time.

A grenade can be thrown with 1 Action, up to 6 meters range.
SingleTable: 3x3 meters; Units hit take 2d8 Smash Damage and are Slammed 4 meters away from the center
5x5 meters; the grenade explodes at the start of your next Turn for 2d10 Smash Damage to Units hit
6x6 meters; all Allies hit get a 1d4 Shielding and can instantly move 1 meter
<Grenade>.Notes:
Each grenade costs 50 {Gold}Gold to craft, but can be freely recovered and repaired after Combat.
Alternatively, you create the grenade and give it to an ally to use (throwable with 1 Action).
You can only have 3 grenades created at a time. You can destroy a grenae to create another one of a different type.

~Mobility Device~.Effect: Spend 200 {Gold}Gold to design a gyroscopically balanced locomotor platform, functioning similarly to a hoverboard or twin-wheel vehicle that gives the rider +1 Movement Speed.
~Mobility Device~.Upgrade: You can only have one mobility device created at any point.

~Force Field~.Range: 5 meters to any part of the field
~Force Field~.Effect:
Immediately raise a thin, 3-meter wide force field.
Any missile passing through the force field get -50% Damage.
~Force Field~.Upgrade: Units can't pass through the field, but it can be deliberately destroyed with a Half-Action.

~Autoturret~.Effect:
Deploy a simple autoturret on a space within 3 meters. It has a 3-meter range.
At the end of your Turn, each autoturret automatically attacks the closest enemy to it within range for 1d4 Pierce Damage.
~Autoturret~.Upgrade:
Each autoturret has 1 Health and costs 50 {Gold}Gold to craft, but can be freely repaired after Combat and carried in the pocket.
You can only have 3 autoturrets deployed at a time.

~Teleportation Zone~.Effect:
Throw a _teleportation pad_ or draw a _teleportation circle_ on a space.
At the start of your next Turn, teleport yourself or an ally near you to it.
~Teleportation Zone~.Upgrade: Beyond a range of 100 meters, the translocative processes may produce anomalous results.

~Toolbelt~.Effect: You possess compact Toolbelt engineered to provide immediate access to one of each Adventuring Gear piece costing at most 100 {Gold}Gold (except food).
~Toolbelt~.Upgrade: If one tool is used once, it replenishes between Adventures.

~Weaponized Arms~.Effect:
Spend 100 {Gold}Gold to fabricate a specialized arm sleeve capable of securely housing and concealing up to 3 weapons inside.
One may rapidly draw and sheathe any of the weapon at will with the move of a finger.
You can only have one special sleeve created at a time.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

~Bionic Eye~.Effect:
Execute a precision operation to integrate a bionic eye into an Ally (or yourself).
The subject gets {Brown('-1 Sense')}, but gains +3 Health Regen, can see in the Dark, can record visuals with the eye, and gains +2 in Sight (or a similar Non-Combat Skill).
~Bionic Eye~.Upgrade: This +2 in Sight can go higher than the Stat Limit.
~Bionic Eye~.Notes: {StatLimit}. Only one operation can be conducted per eye.

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, remember to manually add the extra Health Regen and Skill Points from the My Character tab.

~Embracing Humanity~.Effect: You have extra Health Regen and Skill Points equal to double your Sense.
~Embracing Humanity~.Downside: Unlearning this Talent does remove the Skills and Health Regen added.

~Create Elixir~.Effect:
Choose 2 of the following types of elixirs and create one of each.
When consumed with Half-Action, each elixir has a different effect:
SingleTable: Elixir of Health: Heal for 2d6 Health
Elixir of Strength: +1d4 Damage with first weapon attack each Turn

Popup.Message: After you get this Talent, remember to manually add the desired numbers from the My Character tab.

~Gene Editing~.Effect:
Use your tools to conduct a scientific experiment on a person (even yourself).
They get {Brown('-1 Sense')} but get a random upgrade permanently.
If used on yourself, you gain an extra +1 Health.
SingleTable: 1. +1 Might and +2 Max Health and veins glow in the dark
2. +1 Dexterity and +0.5 Initiative and skin tints to a color
3. +1 Intelligence and +3 Skill Points and eyes change color
4. +4 Health Regen and the inability to feel pain
5. +1 Health, Health Regen and Movement Speed, and +0.5 Initiative
6. The experiment fails and nothing else happens
~Gene Editing~.Notes: These changes are kept even if you change this Talent.

~Mechanical Precision~.Effect: Your next attack, if it's with the same metal weapon as the previous attack, deals exactly the same base weapon Damage.
~Mechanical Precision~.Notes:
Same Damage as after the attack's final Damage roll from the base weapon.
This attack does not trigger Critical Strikes.
If your last Gun attack dealt 11 Damage, use this and your next Gun attack will deal exactly 11 Damage.

~Spell Scroll~.Effect:
You create a special _scroll_.
An Ally (or you) casts a Spell on your _scroll_, which absorbs the spell before it takes effect.
The _scroll_ can be used with Half-Action, and is destroyed after being used.
~Spell Scroll~.Notes: You can only have one Spell Scroll created at a time.

<Reforge Weapon>.Effect: You reforge a weapon to provide 2 from the following benefits:
<Reforge Weapon>.Upgrade: Reforging it again changes the benefit.
SingleTable: Wielder starts Combat with a 1d6 Shielding.

Popup.Message: Once the mask is attacked, remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

~Iron Mask~.Effect:
Spend 150 {Gold}Gold to craft a special _mask_ that can be permanently attached to one's face.

Once attached, the wearer permanently get {Brown('-1 Sense')}, +8 Max Health, +2 Range on all Abilities and attacks, they are immune to being Blinded.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab.

~Body Augmentation~.Effect:
Perform a surgical augmentation to replace one of your biological limbs with a mechanized, gear-driven prosthesis.
Get {Brown('-1 Sense')} permanently.
Gain +2 Health and +1 in Might or Dexterity.
The extra Might or Dexterity can exceed your Stat Limit by up to 2.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).

<Reforge Armor>.Effect: You reforge a set of body armor to provide 1 of the following benefits:
SingleTable: -50% Damage Taken of a chosen non-physical Damage Type
<Reforge Armor>.Upgrade: An armor can only be reforged twice, to have up to 2 different benefits.
<Reforge Armor>.Notes:
After reforging twice, you can keep reforging an armor to change one of its benefits to a different one.
A reforged armor can't have 2 of the same Reforge Armor benefit at a time.

~Give In To Metal~.Effect: Gain a number of Action Points equal to the opposite of your Sense.
~Give In To Metal~.Notes: If your Sense is -2, you gain 2 Action Points.

<Create Golem>.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (or tell your Ally to do so).
<Create Golem>.Effect:
Permanently get {Brown('-1 Sense')} and -1 Health Regen and craft a Golem that does your bidding.

It has Half-Action and takes its Turn on the same Turn as you. It has the Attack Ability, but you need to choose the material it's made out of.
<Create Golem>.Upgrade: Each additional Golem you craft takes -2 Health Regen more than the previous.
<Create Golem>.Notes:
If the Golem is destroyed, you can spend 10 minutes to repair it. You can change its type between Adventures.
The Golem can be stored as a smaller version of itself that expands at the beginning of the Combat, or when thrown somewhere for Half-Action.

~Attack~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike (Clay) - if you rolled 6, Single-Stun the target.
Critical Strike (Flesh) - if you rolled 6, +1d6 Damage.
Critical Strike (Metal) - if you rolled 6, deal the Damage to one more Unit near the target.

~Effect~.Effect:
Brown('Clay:') Enemies ending their Turn near the Clay Golem are Slowed.
Brown('Flesh:') Instead of attacking, pull a Unit up to 5 meters away next to the Golem (Once / Combat).
Brown('Metal:') Allies within 1 meter of the Metal Golem have Cover from Ranged attacks.
~Effect~.Notes: The Flesh Golem can use a hook to pull an enemy to the closest space near the Golem (requires clear path).

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 2d8 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).
~Attack~.Upgrade: If the weapon doesn't make an attack on an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn, it is unsummoned.

~Effect~.Effect:
Brown('Clay:') Enemies ending their Turn near the Clay Golem are Slowed.
Brown('Flesh:') Instead of attacking, pull a Unit up to 5 meters away next to the Golem (Once / Combat).
Brown('Metal:') Allies within 1 meter of the Metal Golem have Cover from Ranged attacks.
~Effect~.Notes: The Flesh Golem can use a hook to pull an enemy to the closest space near the Golem (requires clear path).

~Land Vehicle~.Effect:
Spend 2000 {Gold}Gold to engineer a multi-passenger transport vehicle. Maximum operational velocity is 100 km/h, consuming 50 {Gold} worth of fuel per hour, but it is impractical for combat.
Due to mechanical complexity, the vehicle requires 1 minute of calibration in order to start moving from being stationary.

~Transmute Rock~.Effect:
Select a 1x1x1 meter cube of rock, mud, sand, or similar material and transform it into a different material of similar composition, rarity and worth. A Unit caught in this effect becomes Slowed.
Once per Adventure, you can transmute a piece of metal you can hold in your hand into gold worth up to 400% its original worth in {Gold}Gold.

~Circle of Manifestation~.Effect:
Inscribe a grand alchemical glyph on a flat plane and make a wish, translating your intent into the circle through precise mathematical symbology.
When activating it with your palm, it initiates the transmutation of the inscribed wish into reality, but you pay an unknown cost proportional to your wish's value.

Make a Roll (2d6). The higher you roll, the more accurately you gain what you wished for.
~Circle of Manifestation~.Upgrade: On doubles, there may be complications or bonuses.

~Propulsion Backpack~.Effect:
Spend 400 {Gold}Gold to construct a specialized backpack which generates sustained lift when activated, allowing the user to achieve flight at their normal Speed for up to 1 hour.
The backpack is destroyed once exhausted.

<Alchemy>.Effect: You can use Create Elixir a number of ^extra^ times per Adventure equal to your Sense.

<Adrenaline Steroid>.Effect:
Enter a state of chemical surge until the end of your next Turn.
You get +100% healing on you (from any source) and all your offensive attacks and Abilities consume a Combo to increase their Damage by 100%.
<Adrenaline Steroid>.Notes: Does not work for after-Combat Health Regen.

<Inscription>.Effect: You can use Create Scroll a number of times per Adventure equal to your Sense.

<Create Replica>.Effect:
Fabricate a perfect replica of a non-legendary magic item.
Only one replica of that item can exist, and the previous one must be destroyed in order to use Create Replica again.

<Augmentation>.Effect:
You augment your body using chemical, mechanical or magical procedures.
Your Might and Dexterity increase by 2, your Health by 10

<Transfiguration>.Effect:
You replace your body entirely with magical constructs, and transfuse your mind and consciousness into a different part of your new transcendental body, which can be entirely biological or mechanical in nature.
Your Might and Dexterity increase by 4, your base Defense is 4, and you are Skilled when doing anything with Might, Dexterity or Intelligence.
You no longer age and you are immune to all diseases.

<Master Artifex>.Effect:
All potions and elixirs you create are 2 times as potent. Your Golems, Autoturrets and Grenades deal 100% more Damage.
Once per Adventure, you can create a Magic Item as per the _QM Resources, Homebrewing Magic Items_ page rules and spend Gold for the materials equal to half of the item's gold cost.

<Carbonic Reflection>.Effect:
You create a perfect clone of yourself, that can be biological or mechanical in nature. It resembles you identically in appearance, Stats, personality, etc.
It can cast any Abilities you have access to, but they share a Cooldown. You control both in Combat and they act on the same Turn.
Beware: The clone is intelligent, and while its goals are aligned with yours, it is not guaranteed to always listen to your commands and desires outside of Combat. You decide if its intelligence is natural or artificial, and if your clone is truly sentient or conscious or not.

~Path of the Berserker~.Effect:
Instead of having normal Health Regen, 200% of your Health Regen is added to your Max Health (and as such your Health Regen after combat is always 0).
You can not gain extra Defense except through magical means (magic items, spells, etc).
~Path of the Berserker~.Notes: Increasing Health Regen increases your Max Health instead (and losing Health Regen loses you Max Health instead).

~Onslaught~.Effect: Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy, heal for 1d6 Health. In addition, if an Enemy has 25% or less Health, you know exactly how much Health it has (ask the QM).

~Reckless Charge~.Effect:
Freely dash exactly 2 meters towards a Worthy Enemy, landing on the closest space. It becomes Rooted.
~Your next weapon attack deals 2d6 extra Damage to the target and half of that to yourself.~
You can only use this once on every Worthy Enemy.

~Charge~.Effect: Freely dash up to 2 meters toward a Worthy Enemy that's exactly 2 meters away, landing on a space near them.

~War Craft~.Effect:
No two heroes fight alike. Choose your War Craft from below!
Each War Craft may give you a way to deal {Color('#ff5900' 'extra Damage')} with weapon attacks!
~War Craft~.Upgrade: You may change your War Craft inbetween Adventures.

~Shield Craft~.Effect: Use after you are melee attacked. Deal 1d4 Smash Damage with your {Color('#ff5900' 'shield')} to the attacker.

~Dualwield Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second one-handed')} attack with a real weapon each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if it is with a different weapon than the first attack')}.

~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'two-handed')} weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is an Ally, obstacle or wall directly behind your target')}.

~Throw Craft~.Effect:
You may throw real melee weapons with a 3-5 meter range. They deal -1 Damage for one-handed weapons (or -2 Damage for two-handed weapons).

If your first Act each Turn is a {Color('#ff5900' 'thrown')} weapon attack, it deals +1d4 Damage.

~Unarmed Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second Punch')} attack each Turn deals +1d6 Damage {Color('#ff5900' "if it's not on the same target as your first attack")}.

~Marksman Craft~.Effect: Your first ~ranged~ weapon attack each Turn deals +1d4 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is no Unit or obstacle near the target')}.

~Uncharge~.Effect: Freely dash exactly 2 meters toward an ~Ally~, landing on the closest space, near them.
~Uncharge~.Combo: If the Ally had a Combo, make a free Move Act.

~Dual Shield Craft~.Effect:
You can Dual Wield shields and attack with them for 1d6 + ^Might or Dexterity^ Damage.
After you Charge, gain one Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.

~Improvisation Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'Improvised Attack')} each Turn deals +1d6 Damage {Color('#ff5900' 'if you have never used that object as a weapon')}.

~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'old-fashioned')} weapon attack each Turn deals extra Damage equal to ^Any Stat^, {Color('#ff5900' 'and applies a Combo if the target is a Person')}.
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Upgrade: Old-fashioned weapons are weapons that do not deal extra Damage with any Stat (e.g. Hammer).

~Vault Break~.Effect: Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Sound Mind~.Effect: Block any non-damaging negative incoming _effect_ on an ally you can see.
~Sound Mind~.Upgrade: Negative effects in this case means any Crowd Control, Debuff, Curse, mind-altering magic, non-Damaging Poison, etc.

~Doublesault~.Effect: Leap up to 3 meters. If you land on a Unit, Doublesault again (for free)!
~Doublesault~.Notes:
You leap from Unit to Unit until you no longer land on a Unit. If you land on a Unit, you must leap again. You can't leap on the same Unit twice; if you do, you end your leap in the closest space near it.
You can use this even while in the air and it cancels out your current fall or acceleration.

~Snap Out Of It~.Effect: Attack a different Unit with a 1-handed weapon. It Heals them instead of dealing Damage to them.
~Snap Out Of It~.Notes: Any extra Damage effects on it heal as well (e.g. War Craft, Criticl Strikes, etc). Apply any weapon effects if they happen. The attack might still do Damage to other collateral Units (if applies, e.g. Cleaver to you).

~Strength and Honor~.Effect:
You may exceed the Level limits for maximum Stats.
You start with +1 in any Stat.
~Strength and Honor~.Notes: The maximum a Stat can be until Level 4 is +3. Between 4 and 8 is +4. There is no limit from Level 8 on.

~Bristleback~.Effect: You take less Damage when struck from behind. Enemies with 2 or less Sense...

~Hemmingstep~.Effect: When standing right next to a wall, you take -1 Damage from all sources.

~Painfeast~.Effect: Until the start of your next Turn, all Damage you take is transformed into Healing instead!

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
You jump high up above the battlefield and end your Turn.
At the start of your next Turn, you plunge into the earth like a comet toward a destintion space within 15 meters.
All Units within a zone of 3 meters from your landing point take 3d6 Smash Damage and a crater forms in the zone, 2 meters deep at the extremities of the area.

<Undying Rage>.Effect:
Taking Damage that would kill you puts you in a state of primal rage, and leaves you at 1 Health instead.
For the rest of the Combat, increase all Healing you do on yourself by 50%.

<Blood and Fire>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Strike a Unit for an amount of Fire Damage equal to 50% of your missing Health.

<Primal Trophy>.Effect:
Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy, gain one Primal Trophy. Every 3 Primal Trophies increase your Max Health by 1.
Every 10 Primal Trophies give you an extra non-combat Skill (make you Skilled in a type of activity).

~Bloodlust~.Effect: Add 1d4 Damage to a weapon attack for each 10 Health you are missing.
~Bloodlust~.Notes: This is not considered a Spell.

<Heartbeat Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Then, until the ^end^ of your next Turn, you take 50% less Damage (including from your own Abilities).
When Heartbeat Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Rage Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all your attacks deal +1d4 Damage and Onslaught healing is increased by 100%.
When Rage Trance ends, heal for 1d6.

<Battle Trance>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Until the ^end^ of your next Turn, all Damage you do to yourself becomes Healing instead and you are immune to Crowd Control.
When Battle Trance ends, heal for 2d6.

<Hunger For Blood>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to a Worthy Enemy, heal for 10% of it (rounded down).

<Last Resort>.Effect:
Take 1d6 Damage.
Your next single-target weapon attack deals +1d20 Damage.
For the rest of the Combat, you deal -50% Damage but increase all Healing you do by 50%.

~FURY~.Upgrade: Every time you do Healing or weapon Damage, do +1 for each {Orange('Fury')}, then lose 1 {Orange('Fury')}.

~Painful Puncture~.Effect: Attack a Unit for 1d6 + 2 Damage of your ^weapon^'s type. Its Passives, weapon* effects and Reactions are disabled until the start of your next Turn.
~Painful Puncture~.Notes: Its Passives become disabled before you hit it (e.g. Kobolds don't dodge this attack). Some monsters have special weapon* effects, like Centaurs who gain extra Damage based on how much they moved. These are disabled.

<Blood Craft>.Effect: Whenever you Damage with War Craft to a Worthy Enemy, Damage yourself equal to the original roll, then increase it by 100% to the enemy.

<Death Mark>.Effect:
Mark a Unit you can see.
Whenever YOU deal Damage to it until your next Turn, remember the Damage done.
At the start of your next Turn, the mark bursts and the Unit takes directly 33% of the Damage you dealt to it in this time period.

<Earthshattering Wave>.Effect:
All units in a line must succeed a Might Check against _10% of your Max Health_ or be Triple-Stunned. If they succeed, they become Fumbling instead.
The line is 3 meters wide, and has a length of 1 meter for ever 5 Health you are missing.
<Earthshattering Wave>.Notes:
E.g. if you have 30 out of 50 Health (thus missing 20 Health), then the line will be 4 meters long.
Cover is applied normally.

<Ruining Shout>.Effect:
Damages all Enemies within 4 meters of you.
Deals 1d6 Psychic Damage for each 1 meter to the target (up to 4d6).
Roll 4d6 at the same time, and choose which dice affect the units closer.

<Tribal Tattoos>.Effect:
Your Max Health is further increased by 8.
Every Adventure, you add another tattoo and increase it by 1.
Every 3 new tattoos, gain +1 in any Resist Check of choice.

<One With My Body>.Effect: Choose any Druid or Hunter Utility Talent from any Level.

<Victory Strike>.Effect:
Attack a Unit for 2d10 Damage of your weapon's type.
Whenever ^YOU^ kill a Worthy Enemy (with anything), reset the Cooldown of this Ability.

<Frenzy>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 25 or less Health, you have +1 Movement Speed and can Break your Movement.
if you start with 15 or less Health, you also have an extra Half-Action.

<Hurl Over>.Effect:
Grab another non-Epic Unit and throw them up to 10 meters away.
Upon landing, all other Units within 3 meters of the landing place take 3d8 Pulse Damage.
If it was an Enemy, the Thrown Unit takes 50% of the Damage.

<Jotunn>.Effect:
You grow to the size of a giant and become Large.
You gain Shielding equal to 50% of your missing Health.
Your normal Melee attacks hit all Units within 1 meter of the target for the same Damage, without the Stat modifier (e.g. you don't add your Might or Dexterity to the secondary targets).
You are immune to being Crowd Control and Hard Terrain.

<Echoes of Fury>.Effect: Your _echoes_ can hit the same target (with -50% Damage/Healing). However, if it hits a different target, the Damage or Healing is no longer reduced by 50%.

<Forced Echoes>.Effect: Your Shaman Abilities and Talents always _echo_.
<Forced Echoes>.Notes: Rainmaking applies 2 effects when echoed. Enlightening Ritual can now, instead, succeed twice per Adventure (Units still can't succeed it more than once).

<Bloodbath>.Effect: You heal for all Damage done by Advanced Flank on Worthy Enemies.

<Echoing Self>.Effect: A spectral self appears at the position where you started your turn, and repeats all Acts you have already done this turn.
<Echoing Self>.Notes:
An Act is considered any Movement, attack or Ability that took at least 0 Actions (does not include Passives that triggered and _echoes_ that had already happened this turn).
The clone moves exactly as you did (can go through Units) and repeats the Spells and Attacks on the same targets. If there were any dice rolls, the clone rolls them (don't use the same numbers rolled). The clone is a separate special Unit - self effects apply to the clone (and thus self-heals have no effect).

<Flesh of Iron>.Effect:
You Heal for all Damage you would deal to yourself instead of taking it. Pierce, Slash and Smash attacks can't Damage you below 1 Health (they leave you to 1 Health).
Also, passively, you gain +2 Might.

<Ferocity Unleashed>.Effect:
If you start your turn with 50% or less Health, you have an extra 1 Action on your turn.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might, Dexterity and Sense, you are immune to exhaustion in Worthy Combat and you can survive without sleep for 7 days.
<Ferocity Unleashed>.Notes: This stacks with the Frenzy Talent.

<MIGHT BRAWN MUSCLE>.Effect: GAIN +10 MIGHT AND THE RESULTS OF ALL YOUR MIGHT CHECKS ARE DOUBLED.

~Sentient Weapon~.Effect:
You have a Witchblade Weapon - a special weapon of one chosen type (e.g. Shortsword, Longbow, Pike, etc). This weapon will have extra effects later on. Don't lose it!
You gain +1 in Might or Dexterity, up to +3.
~Sentient Weapon~.Upgrade: Reposess: By spending 1 hour, you can transfer the curse of your Witchblade Weapon into another weapon. That new weapon becomes your Witchblade Weapon, and the old one is destroyed.
~Sentient Weapon~.Notes:
You are bound by soul to your Witchblade Weapon, inside which your patron's avatar lies, either possessing the weapon, being trapped inside it, cursing it, or using it as a means of communication with you.
You must choose your weapon type when you become a Witchblade Witchblade.
You can customize your weapon's personality, voice, the way it looks. Talk to your Quest Master.

~Witchblade~.Effect: After you cast a Spell that costs Mana, your next Witchblade Weapon attack deals 1d6 extra Damage (within 5 minutes).
~Witchblade~.Notes: You can only add the 1d6 once per turn. The d6's can stack (from multiple Spells that cost Mana, one after another).

~Hail~.Effect: Blast a Unit for 2d8 + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.
~Hail~.Combo: Targets an extra Unit in range for 1d8 + ^that Unit's Might^.
~Hail~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Wyrd Renewal~.Effect:
Roll 1d12 - 5. After you see the result, choose a Worthy Unit.
If it's negative, deal Scourge Damage to it. Otherwise, heal it.

{Evoke}: +100% Damage or Healing per Evoke Point spent.

~Deathfire Flame~.Effect: Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d6 + 1d8 + 1d10 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

~Curse of Weakness~.Effect: Choose a Unit. The first time it deals Damage on its every Turn, roll 1d4 and subtract it from its dealt Damage.

~Curse of Pain~.Effect: Choose a Unit. At the start of each of your Turns, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage.

~Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 5d4 Psychic Damage and becomes Deafened or Dazed (its choice).
Apply a ~Combo~ to it.
~Psyche Blast~.Notes: Cover is applied normally. Note that Single-Stuns can stack to become Double-Stunned or Triple-Stunned.

~Disenchantment~.Effect: A person you can see must pass a Sense Roll against your Sense Roll or have -2 to non-combat Rolls and be afflicted by minor curse effects (e.g. is clumsy, stumbles, get pimples, etc).
~Disenchantment~.Notes: Be creative with the effects of the minor curse effects!

~Compel~.Duration: Lasts until they can't see/hear you
~Compel~.Effect: Choose a Unit you can see. You have +1d2 to Sense Rolls against it.
~Compel~.Notes: The target can't tell it was affected unless it knows about this type of magic.

~Oculus~.Effect:
You conjure a magical eye that records everything it sees. It can be a Tuner Eye or Recording Eye.
At will, a Tuner Eye allows you to see what it sees, live, in your mind.
A Recording Eye records everything it sees. You can retrieve it to see everything recorded in it.

~Thaumaturgy~.Effect:
You create one of the following magical effects:
{Diamond} Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute.

{DarkGreen('People:')} Your next attack Cripples the target.
{DarkGreen('Undead:')} Your pet's next attack Single-Stuns the target.

<Pet Training 101>.Effect:
Choose one more Pet Talent.
While you have this Talent, your pet also has that Pet Talent.

<Fang and Claw>.Requirement: You can only have Fang and Claw once
<Fang and Claw>.Effect: Pet Attack deals 1d6 Damage instead of 1d4.

<Bandage Wounds>.Effect: Heal a Unit for 1d4 for each 10 Health it is missing.

<Pet Versatile Trainings>.Effect: When you get this Talent and at the end of every Adventure, you can change one Pet Talent of one of your pets.

~Lance Heave~.DisplayRequirement: Only usable if it hits at least 2 Units
~Lance Heave~.Effect:
Make a {Weapon} ^weapon^ attack {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Lance Heave~.Combo: Comboed Units take the original full Damage.
~Lance Heave~.Notes:
Can apply weapon effects. If the weapon effect requires a target, applies to one chosen Unit hit.
Range increases do increase the length. The Damage must the same for all Units hit. All bonuses to the attack (e.g. Smite, Cursewielder, etc) also split evenly.

Variants.Name: Lance Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Blade Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits all Units in a 3-meter long line. The Damage is evenly split among all hit Units.

Variants.Name: Penetrating Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

Variants.Name: Piercing Heave
Variants.Effect: that hits one more Unit up to 2 meters directly behind the main target.

<Crosshair Shot>.Effect:
Make an attack on a target.
For each meter to the target, the attack deals 1d6 Pierce Damage, up to 8 meters.
For each meter to the target over 8 meters, deal -1d6 Damage.
<Crosshair Shot>.Notes: At exactly 8 meters range, the attack deals 8d6 Damage. At 7 and 9 meters, it deals 7d6. At 6 and 10 meters, 6d6. And so on.

~Tag-Team Mark~.Effect:
Choose and mark a target you can see. ~Your Pet immediately dashes to the target and performs a Pet Attack if it's within 6 meters of the target.~
Your own ~and your pet's~ single target attacks and Abilities against the marked target have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

~Chaser Mark~.Effect:
Choose and mark a target you can see. ~If it's a non-Epic Unit, it is perpetually Single-Stunned while Marked.~
Your own single target attacks and Abilities against the marked target have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

<Pet Training 102>.Effect:
Choose one more Pet Talent.
While you have this Talent, your pet also has that Pet Talent.

<Treesposition>.Effect: Touch a piece of of a Large or larger piece of wood. Teleport near a similar piece of wood within 6 meters.

<Tremor Wave>.Effect:
Shoot a thundering shot towards an obstacle or wall. A quaking wave travels horizontally towards in both directions of the wall up to 10 meters in each direction.
All Units within 2 meters of that wall must succeed a Might Check at least equal to your Sense Check or be Triple-Stunned and take 3d4 Shock Damage.
They take half of the Damage and are Single-Stun even if they pass.
<Tremor Wave>.Notes: The floor and ceiling are not considered walls. The wave does not travel through them. This is considered a Spell. Ignores Cover.

<Improved Hunter Mark>.Effect: Hunter Mark makes your ^Dice^ further ^Upgraded^ to the next die type.

<Leafwalk>.Effect: You and your pet become ^invisible^. While a Unit is _leafwalking_, it heals for 1d4 whenever it does an Act. Lasts until the end of your next turn (or for 12 seconds if not in combat).

<Stat Bonuses 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in two Stats of choice, up to +5.

<Stat Bonuses 4 Extra>.Effect: Gain +1 in three Stats of choice, up to +4.

<Pierce and Cleave>.Effect:
When making a single-target attack on a Unit, your attack hits another target, depending on the weapon range:
{Diamond} If ranged, the attack hits the first Unit directly behind the main target within 3 meters of it, on a line, for 50% of the base Damage of the attack.
{Diamond} If melee, the attack hits one Unit of choice within 2 meters of the target, for 50% of the base Damage of the attack.

<Marked for Criticals>.Effect: After you use Hunter Mark (or an upgrade) on a target, it takes maximum Damage from the next dice roll.
<Marked for Criticals>.Notes: For example, after you Hunter Mark a Unit, if you attack it for 2d8 Damage, you don't roll; it just takes 16 Damage. Applies to bonuses like Dice Upgrades, Smites, etc.

<Eye of the Hawk>.Effect:
All enemies in a Worthy Combat are automatically _Marked_, and your range increases by 500% and your ^Dice^ are further ^Upgraded^ to the ^next^ die type against _Marked_ Units. After manually casting Hunter Mark, your first attack deals 50% more Damage against that Unit.
You automatically pass all Hard Dexterity Checks (that require at least 15) and your Sense and Dexterity increase by an extra 2.

<Eye of the Raptor>.Effect:
Your attacks deal maximum Damage to Units that are not _Marked_ if they are within 3 meters of you or your Pet.
You automatically pass all Hard Sense Checks (that require at least 15) and you gain +3 Sense.

~Prowl Around~.Effect: You have +2 to all non-Combat Sense Rolls.
~Prowl Around~.Notes: This is because of your Animal Companions roaming about.

~Stablemaster~.Effect:
You have 3 different Animal Companion pets, but only one can adventure with you at a time.
Each of your Animal Companions has 2 Pet Talents, and you can distribute your Minor Level 1 Talents among your pets as you like.

While not with you, your other Animal Companions hang out on their own in the wilderness, but no more than 5 kilometers away from you.
You can send your current companion off, then spend 30 minutes to call for another one to come join you.
~Stablemaster~.Notes:
The advantage is you can use several animal Abilities that have longer Cooldowns; these are usually stronger.
It is possible that the animal you're calling can't come to your aid if you're indoors, flying or the trail you're on is too difficult. In that case, you will have to return outside or on a safe trail (QM's decision).
In that case, your current companion can not go away, either.

~Infused Bites~.Effect: You can change your pet's attacks' Damage Type to {Type}.

<Kindred Spirits>.Effect:
One more of your Animal Companions accompanies you while adventuring.
This Animal Companion obeys the same rules as the regular one (takes its Turns, requires Healing between combats, etc).
<Kindred Spirits>.Notes: You're instantly kicked from the group if your pets don't have names.

<Singular Apex>.Effect: Each of your Animals now has 4 instead of 2 Pet Talents, +100% Health and deals 2d6 Pet Attack Damage instead of 1d6.

<Double Training>.Effect: Teach each of your Animal Companions one more Pet Talent.

<Ravage!>.Effect:
One pet makes a melee Attack for 5d6 Slash Damage.
If the target is at or below 50% Health, deal 2d6 extra Damage and the target halves all healing it receives for the rest of the encounter.
<Ravage!>.Notes: This takes 1 Action from YOU, not your pet.

<Sickem>.Effect:
Use when a Unit goes flying against its will on someone else's turn.
Your pet(s) within 5 meters of its landing place can dash to it (after it lands) and make a total of 2 Pet Attacks on it.
<Sickem>.Notes:
Goes flying means is pushed, knocked up, dragged, etc.
This uses YOUR Reaction, not your pets'.
Obviously, your pets need line of sight and can't jump through walls, or over large obstacles. Apply common sense.

~Search~.Effect:
Name or describe a Unit that is familiar to you. Your animals go and search for your target.
They point which direction (straight) the target is.

<Coordinated Bite>.Effect: One enemy near each of your pets (and/or summons) becomes Single-Stunned, Blinded and Deafened.

<Call To Action>.Effect: Call to one more of your animal companions! It appears from the wilderness and fights for up to 1 minute as if it were a normal Animal Companion.

<Second Winds>.Effect: Instantly heal yourself and all your pets for 3d6.

<Shapeshifting Pet>.Effect:
Turn one of your pets into a different animal type from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`. If it's enhanced by a Talent, it keeps all enhancements (e.g. from Large Double).
Passively, your Pets gain +3 in all Stats, +10 Health, +2 Movement Speed and +1d4 Damage on all attacks.
<Shapeshifting Pet>.Upgrade: If you have the Wild Single Talent, you can turn a pet into a combination of 2 Animals.

<Cryptid Tamer>.Effect:
One of your Animal Companions becomes a Beast, Dragon or Insect from the `Monsters page$/Other/Monsters` worth less than 500 XP. It doesn't have a regular Pet Attack, but it has exactly the Abilities and attacks, but only 50% of its Max Health. It obeys the rest of your Animal Companion rules as normal.
Passively, your Pets automatically pass all Very Hard Sense Checks (requiring at least 20).

~Liberating Judgement~.Effect:
Deal 2d4 Damage to a Unit (you choose the Damage Type).

{Teal('With Valor:')} Then move a number of meters equal to the lower of the dice.
{Teal('Next:')} Damaging Act

~Liberation~.Effect: Instantly remove all Crowd Control from another ally you can see.
~Liberation~.Upgrade:
At Level 5, also removes all non-magical debuffs and poisons.
At Level 8, also removes all curses and normal negative magical effects.

Popup.Message: Remember to manually change the Stats and numbers from the My Character tab (and tell your Ally to do so).

~Nominate Squire~.Effect:
Nominate a Hero from your party to become your _squire_ - your trusted companion and helper in your quest.

Your squire gets -2 Max Health, but you get +3 Max Health.
Whenever one of you would get a Quirk, you can choose to deny it, and be given a different Quirk that fits the situation.
~Nominate Squire~.Upgrade:
Your squire has doubled inventory capacity and you can instantly swap items from eachother with 0 Actions (if near eachother).
They also have +2 in War Machines.

~Vows~.Requirement: Only usable in Campaigns with multiple sessions
~Vows~.Effect:
Vow on achieving a goal that would take at least 1 full Adventure.
Upon reaching your goal, you get a number of Positive Quirks equal to the number of sessions it took.
~Vows~.Upgrade: You can only have one vow at a time. Abandoning a vow gives you a Negative Quirk.

~Trusted Steed~.Effect:
You have a steed that increases ^your^ non-Combat movement speed 50%.
When dismounting, your steed runs away and disappears into the surroundings.
Once per real hour, you can whistle for your steed and it will appear running toward you and you automatically mount it.
~Trusted Steed~.Notes: The steed can be any animal that fits the story. The steed does not participate in Combat.

~Actions With Valor~.Effect:
Your Abilities and attacks in Worthy Combat have bonus effects if made {Teal('With Valor')}.
An Ability triggers its {Teal('Valor')} effect if it was made immediately after another Ability's {Teal('Next')}.
~Actions With Valor~.Upgrade: Valor carries on to the next Turn, but not to the next Combat (you start each Combat without Valor).
~Actions With Valor~.Notes: For example, on your first Turn, you use Knockback (Level 1 Minor Talent). It does not trigger the With Valor part, so you Slam a Unit 1d4 meter. It says "Offensive Damage Ability" at "Next", so you use Row Through, which activates its With Valor effect, hitting one more. It says "Healing Ability" at "Next", so you can use Stand Strong, Fellows to heal for 1d4 instead of 1d2. And so on. You can't activate With Valor or Next outside Worthy Combat. You start each Worthy Combat without Valor.

~Challenge of Arms~.Effect:
Heal yourself for 1d4, or move 1d4 meters.
Then deal 1d8 Smash Damage to a Unit, or Slam it 1d6 meters.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Do it again!
{Teal('Next:')} Any other Ability
~Challenge of Arms~.Notes: Use this to start a chain of Abilities With Valor! When you repeat this, choose the effects again and roll dice as normal. Obviously, the repeat does not retrigger another repeat.

~Row Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with +1 Range.

{Teal('With Valor:')} +1d4 Damage and hits one more Unit within 2 meters of the main target with -50% Damage.
{Teal('Next:')} Healing Ability

~Stand Strong, Fellows~.Effect:
Heal all Units within 1 meter of you for 1d2.

{Teal('With Valor:')} 1d4 Healing instead
{Teal('Next:')} Movement Ability

~Champion's Gallop~.Effect:
Make a Move Act with +2 Movement Speed.
~You have access to all Variants of this Ability (click on the icon to select the preferred effect)!~

{Teal('With Valor:')} {Effect}
{Teal('Next:')} Crowd Control Ability

Variants.Effect: All Units you pass near take 1d4 Damage (requires a mount).
Gain one Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.

~Provocation~.Effect:
Slam a Unit 3 meters toward you, or 3 meters away from you.

{Teal('With Valor:')} If toward you, Taunt it. If away from you, Daze it.
{Teal('Next:')} Other Offensive Damage Ability

~Lance Unbound~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack. The target gains a Combo.

{Teal('With Valor:')} +1d4 Damage for each Action Point it costs.
{Teal('Next:')} Movement Ability

~Self-Sacrifice~.Effect:
Take 2d6 True Damage. Heal a different ally for 200% of the rolled amount.

{Teal('With Valor:')} They gain +1 Health Regen for the rest of the Adventure.
{Teal('Next:')} Crowd Control Ability
~Self-Sacrifice~.Notes: Can not be used on other Knights.

~Blockade~.Effect:
When another Unit would take Damage, dash to the closest space to that ally.
You take the ^exact Damage^ instead of the Unit.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Block 1d4 of that Damage.
{Teal('Next:')} Offensive Damage Ability
~Blockade~.Upgrade: This Damage can only be mitigated by Shielding.

~Templar Retribution~.Effect:
Single-Stun a Unit.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Double-Stun instead and gain 4d10 {Gold}Gold.
{Teal('Next:')} Healing Ability

~Creed of the Crown~.Effect:
You serve the realm above all else. Your sword defends law, order, and your liege's will.

You are immune to being Slowed, Rooted, and to Hard Terrain.
At the end of your Turn, give yourself or an ally a Shielding equal to 50% and gain {Gold}Gold equal to 200% the number of meters you moved this Turn.

~Creed of the Rose~.Effect:
You are the knight of beauty and grace, a protector of the innocent, and a paragon of compassion.

You get +4 Max Health.
All your Healing or Shielding Abilities not done with Valor are automatically made with Valor.
If they were already done with Valor, they do +50% Healing or Shielding.

~Creed of the Dragon~.Effect:
You swear your allegiance to an elder dragon you have encountered on your journey.

You take -50% Damage from that dragon's element Type.
When dealing Damage with an Ability that was cast With Valor, 50% of the main target's Damage is also dealt to all Units within 1 meter of the target (of your dragon's element Type).

~Creed of Vengeance~.Requirement: Requires having been betrayed this Campaign
~Creed of Vengeance~.Effect:
Justice has failed. Your oath was broken, your faith was betrayed, but you swore a new one: to hunt those who wronged you and make the world remember.

Whenever you buff an Ally, also apply that buff to yourself.
Once per Ability, when applying Crowd Control to a Unit, it takes 1d4 Scourge Damage. Then another Unit within 2 meters of it must pass a Might Roll at least equal to your Highest Stat Roll or also be affected by that Crowd Control and extra Scourge Damage.
~Creed of Vengeance~.Notes: The secondary Crowd Control does not retrigger Creed of Vengeance.

~Creed of the Sun~.Effect:
~Heal yourself for 1d8 and move up to 1d4 meters~.
Deal ~1d12~ Fire Damage to a Unit ~and Slow it~.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Do it again!
{Teal('Next:')} Any other Ability
~Creed of the Sun~.Upgrade: You are the dawn that banishes despair. You ride with the light at your back and hope in your hand.

~No Matter What~.Effect:
At the end of your every Turn, heal for an amount equal to the Round Number.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Also heals an Ally you can see
{Teal('Next:')} TBD

~CATAPULT!~.Effect:
Craft a special catapult that you can take with you on your adventures.
It can't move on its own, but once per Round, it can be activated with a Half-Action to be pushed 4 meters, or shoot a 3x3 area within 10 meters. All Units hit take 2d6 Smash Damage.

~Affray Through~.Effect:
Make a weapon attack with +1 Range.

{Teal('With Valor:')} Hits one more Unit within 2 meters of the main target.
{Teal('Next:')} Healing Ability
~Affray Through~.Notes: ~This upgrade no longer does reduced Damage to the secondary target.~

<Fellowship Aura>.Effect:
You stand out for allies near you.
Enemy ranged attacks against other allies within 1 meter of you have Cover.
<Fellowship Aura>.Notes: Nothing happens if an ally near you already has Cover. If playing on a grid, this does work for allies diagonally.

<Banner of Honor>.Effect:
Activate and fling a Banner on a space within 5 meters, dealing 1d8 Damage to Units it lands on or next to.
Allies (and you) starting their Turn within 2 meters of the banner start with +Half-Action.

{Teal('With Valor:')} +1000% Range and +200% Damage to Enemies
{Teal('Next:')} Any non-Damage Ability.
<Banner of Honor>.Upgrade: The banner counts as a Unit with 10 Health, but can't take Area Damage.
<Banner of Honor>.Notes: The banner's effect only applies if it's planted into the ground. To be moved, the banner can be picked up with a Half-Action, and thrown again with a Half-Action to reposition and deal the Damage again.

~Get Up, Stand Up~.Effect:
Remove all your party members' Exhaustion (from any source).
If they were Exhausted from lack of sleep, they can resist sleep Exhaustion for 8 more hours.

<Knight in Black>.Effect:
Single-Stuns have no effect on your. Double-Stuns and Triple-Stuns only reduce your Actions by 1 and 2 (respectively).
While there are no allies within 4 meters of you, all your weapon attacks and self healing have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next dice type.
<Knight in Black>.Notes:
{DiceUpgrade}.
While _alone_, your healing Abilities have their Dice Upgraded when healing yourself.

<Man of Steel>.Effect: If you're wearing Heavy Armor or a Shield, you have +1 Defense and +5 Max Health.

<White Knighthood>.Effect: While at or above 35 Health and wearing white clothes, all your Abilities have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.

~Affiance Casting~.Effect:
You have 2 Mana Points that can't increase except through Warlock Talents.
Your Mana replenishes after each Worthy Combat.

~Power Source~.Effect:
Your powers have an external source. Choose another Class and an Element. You can get Level 1 Talents from that Class.
You take -50% Damage from that Element.
~Power Source~.Upgrade: You are bound to a Power Source: something vast, unknowable, or unstable. It might be a pact, a curse, a parasite, a god, or a force of nature. You choose what it is, and when the power speaks you listen.
~Power Source~.Notes: The Class and Element you choose must be thematically tied to your power source, but you can theme it however you want! Be creative!

~Flow Tap~.Effect: Choose an enemy Unit. Cast the last Ability it cast (can include attacks).
~Flow Tap~.Notes: Includes weapon attacks, multiattacks, spells, bodily actions, etc. You can't cast Reactions, Passives or Abilities triggered through Passives. If you copied an attack, you briefly conjure a weapon for the attack only. If the Ability uses any Stats, use yours.

~Flow Tap~.Effect: Choose an enemy Unit. Cast the last Ability it cast (can include attacks).
~Flow Tap~.Notes: Includes weapon attacks, multiattacks, spells, bodily actions, etc. You can't cast Reactions, Passives or Abilities triggered through Passives. If you copied an attack, you briefly conjure a weapon for the attack only. If the Ability uses any Stats, use yours.

~Mind's Shadow~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Sense or Intelligence^ Scourge Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take Scourge Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).

<Control Crowds>.Effect: Use when an enemy Unit uses an Ability. It must use a different Ability.
<Control Crowds>.Notes: If it has only one Ability or attack, you can't use Control Crowds (the QM will let you know).

<Soul Drain>.Effect:
Deal 8 Scourge Damage to a Unit.
If it dies and it was Worthy, you get the Mana back and heal you or an ally for half of the Damage done.
<Soul Drain>.Upgrade: Also, passively, you always know if a Unit would die from this (the QM will answer yes or no).

<Mana Flow Tapping>.Effect: If Flow Tap is on Cooldown, you can spend 1 Mana to cast it regardless.

<Power Tap>.Effect:
Cast an Ability one of your Allies has (with that ability's Actions and Costs and your modifiers).
If it costs Mana, you must spend its Mana.
<Power Tap>.Notes:
Does not work on Passives. The Ability must have 0, a Half-Action or 1 Actions cost.
The Cooldown applies to you - you can Power Tap an Ability that's on Cooldown. After you use it, it goes on Cooldown for you, not for your Ally.

<Patron Aspect>.Effect:
You take on the shape or a being from your patron's plane until the end of your next turn.
Your Basic Spells require no mana to cast.
After you cast a Basic Spell, it goes on a Once / Adventure Cooldown (can't be used until the next Adventure).

<Redirection>.Effect: Use when an Unit uses an Ability or attacks. Redirect it to any other valid Unit (e.g. within range). Its Damage or Healing is reduced by 50%.

~Shadow Clone~.Effect:
You create an illusion of yourself at a target location.
The illusion has 1 Health and 1 Defense and it fails all Checks.
You can control what the illusion does at will.
If the illusion goes more than 10 meters away from you, it disappears and the spell is cancelled.
~Shadow Clone~.Upgrade: At Level 7, the cast range and illusion range become 15 meters and the sound of your voice can come through the illusion's mouth instead of yours. At Level 5 - 25 meters. At Level 7 you can choose to see through the illusion's eyes at any point.
~Shadow Clone~.Notes: You need maintain line of sight to the clone to keep it working.

~Aging~.Effect:
Touch a Unit or object for 1 minute.
It ages up to 1 year in that 1 minute.
~Aging~.Upgrade: Units can only be aged for 1 minute per in-game day.

<Nuissance to Gods>.Cooldown: All your Abilities with "Once / Combat" Cooldown can be used Twice / Encounter instead.

<Possession>.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see.
You possess its body and, on its next turn, you control what it does.
<Possession>.Upgrade:
Only works on targets with Sense less than 3.
The QM will tell you what the Unit can do if it's a monster.

<Advanced Talent Bonus>.Effect: Gain one more Level 3 Talent, ^or^ one more Level 5 Talent.

<Curse of Domination>.Effect:
Choose a Unit you can see. Pass an Intelligence or Charisma Check at least equal to 5% of its Experience Worth to permanently put it under your control. You can command it telepathically what to and it will do your bidding.
You can only have one dominated Unit at a time and lasts until the Unit dies, until you dominate another Unit or until you willingly end the curse.
Also, passively, you gain +3 Charisma.
<Curse of Domination>.Upgrade: Failing the Check makes the Unit permanently immune to Hand of Domination and it can sense they resisted an attempt of possession. A dominated Unit has the same combat capabilities and acts like themselves but is essentially a _philosophical zombie_ - they feel no emotion, have no will of their own and manifest little sentiment in their speech and expressiveness. When the Unit stops being dominated, they recall nothing that has happened in that period of time.

<Whispers of Oblivion>.Effect:
Gain a Half-Action this Turn and get -1 in a random Stat permanently.
Upon reaching 0 or less in all Stats, you become permanently possessed by the energies of your power source. Each of your Stats becomes a random of 1d8 permanently.
Reaching 0 or less in all Stats immediately kills you, and both your and your patron's souls are sent to the other plane forever.
<Whispers of Oblivion>.Upgrade: Your soul is sent into a different plane, according to your patronage. From then on, you have the same body, but you are now your patron for all intents and purposes - in mind, personality and soul.

<Mirror Mirror>.Effect:
Summon a clone of yourself on a space within 5 meters. You control the clone and it resembles you perfectly.
In Combat, the clone acts on your Turn. It has Movement of its own, but will always use its Actions to copy all Basic Abilities and Weapon Attacks you make, on the same target.
<Mirror Mirror>.Notes: The clone can't do combat Acts and fine motor skills on its own -- it will always copy yours in parallel.

~Faith Casting~.Effect:
You have 2 Mana Points that can't increase.
Your Mana replenishes inbetween Worthy Combats.

~Holy Grace~.Requirement: Only usable in Worthy Combat. Can't be used on Fallen Units.
~Holy Grace~.Effect:
Heal a Unit for 1d6 (but not yourself).
Your next attack until the end of your next Turn deals extra Damage equal to the amount just Healed.

~Divine Sense~.Effect: When you use this, for a brief moment, nearby holy and unholy presences emmit a subtle sound and smell ^only you can detect^.
~Divine Sense~.Notes:
Unholiness smells sulphurous and sounds like a deep, echoing rumbling or breath. Holiness smells churchly and sounds like a reverbing crystaline ringing.
Walls block this smell and sound as they normally would.
This smell and sound can only be concealed with magic.

~Smite~.Effect:
After you roll Damage for a melee attack or Spell made in melee range, add 1d6 Divine Damage.
If the target dies, regain 1 Mana.
~Smite~.Combo: Heal for the extra Damage dealt.
~Smite~.Notes: Melee range is 1 meter, longer if made with a Weapon with longer range.

~Invigorate~.Effect:
Heal a target for 1d4 + ^Presence or Intelligence^ Health.
After this, if the target is at full Health, repeat this on another target within 5 meters of you.
~Invigorate~.Combo: If the target is Comboed and still not full Health, increase the Healing by 50%.
~Invigorate~.Notes: Yes, this can chain again and again.

~Safeguard~.Effect:
A Unit you can see gains 2 Shieldings. Each can block 1d8 Damage.
Each die that rolled maximum applies a ~Combo~.

~Knighthood~.Effect: While mounted, after moving in a straight line at least 3 meters, your first attack this turn also hits a Unit directly behind the main target for 50% of the incoming Damage.
~Knighthood~.Combo: Each Comboed Unit hit becomes Single-Stunned.

~Light~.Effect:
Create a faithful source of light in a 3 meters radius (of any color).
It levitates and stays where you put it and can be moved by hand, or you can simply stick it to any solid object.
~Light~.Notes:
You may cancel it with 0 Actions. It can be purposefully destroyed with an Attack.
The light is not strong enough to blind someone.
The bulb can't go through solid objects.

~Guidance~.Effect: When an ally makes a Check, it can use your modifiers (including being Skilled in that Skill) instead of its own.

~Expelling Bolt~.Effect: Shoot a magical bolt towards a Unit that deals 3d8 + (target's Movement Speed) Fire or Divine Damage to it.

~Gaiety~.Effect: After you cast a Utility Spell, immediately make a Move Act (for free) or apply a ~Combo~ to an ally.

~Crusade~.Effect: When ^YOU^ defeat one Worthy Enemy, all excess Damage is converted to healing or Divine Damage to a Unit within 5 meters of you.
~Crusade~.Notes: E.g. if a Unit has 5 Health and you deal 12 Damage, the Unit dies and you heal an ally (or yourself) for 7 Health using your Reaction, or blast another Unit for 7 Divine Damage. If you kill multiple Units at the same time, this triggers only for one of them, of your choice. Excess Damage from Crusade can also trigger Crusade.

~True Sense~.Effect:
When you use this, for a brief moment, nearby ~presences with souls~ emmit a subtle sound and smell ^only you can detect^.
A random one gets a ~Combo and is Single-Stunned~.
~True Sense~.Upgrade: Unholiness smells sulphurous and sounds like a deep, echoing rumbling or breath. Holiness smells churchly and sounds like a reverbing crystaline ringing. Normal souls smell like clean mineral water and sound like a flowing waterfall.
~True Sense~.Notes:
Walls block this smell and sound as they normally would.
The smell and sound can be concealed with magic.

~Crimson Contrition~.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage to multiple Units at the same time, increase all Divine and Fire Damage you deal by 10% for the rest of the Combat (including that Damage).

<Join the Crusade>.Effect: A party member pledges to you. They have the Crusade Ability, and the same Level 1 and 2 Talents (including Utility) you have..
<Join the Crusade>.Upgrade: Ask a party member to join your cause and pledge their honor to you. Write a set of vows, which your companion must vow to abide to and follow with their life, upon death do you two apart.
<Join the Crusade>.Notes:
Only one person can pledge for you and it must within sight or hearing to have access to all of those.
If you ever change this Talent, the ally loses access to all things mentioned; it regains them when you get this Talent again.

~Seal of the Aurora~.Effect: Whenever you heal a Unit to full Health, heal another Unit within 5 meters of it for 50% of the amount healed.
~Seal of the Aurora~.Upgrade: The secondary heals can trigger Seal of the Aurora again.

~Flaming Reach~.Effect:
Your second and all further melee attacks each Turn deal +1d4 Damage on targets you haven't attacked this Turn.
Their range is 3 meters and all their Damage becomes Fire.

~Exorcism~.Effect:
Deal 5d10 True Damage to a Unit.
If it's a Demon, Fiend or Undead, increase the Damage by 50%.

~Radiance~.Effect: For 1 minute, at the end of your Turn, all Units within 1 meter of you take 1d4 Divine Damage.
~Radiance~.Notes: Can't stack multiple Radiances on the same Unit.

<Golden Shield>.Effect:
Use before a Unit you can see would take Damage (before the roll), or on your Turn.
It becomes surrounded in a divine golden shield.
This (or next) time it would take Damage, it is completely blocked.
If used on your Turn, apply a Combo.

~Blinding Light~.Effect:
All Units in a 4x4 meter area take 2d4 Divine Damage and are Blinded.

If only one Unit is hit by the area, it instead takes 5d4 Divine Damage and is Crippled.
~Blinding Light~.Notes: Cover is calculated from the center of the area.

~Smiting Fireheart~.Effect: After you defeat a ^Worthy Enemy^, your next attack deals +50% Damage (but can't retrigger Fire Dexterity).

~Eye for Revolution~.Effect: Your melee attacks deal +25% Damage for each Crowd Control they have (Double-Stun counts as 2 and Triple-Stun counts as 3). The Damage of those attacks becoms Fire.

<Jihad>.Effect:
When healing yourself with Crusade, increase the healing by 50%.
Additionally, you can heal yourself with Holy Grace.

~Spreading Exigency~.Effect: When a Unit becomes Crowd Controlled, all Enemies within 3 meters of it must pass a Dexterity Check against your Dexterity Check, or also be affected by that Crowd Control.
~Spreading Exigency~.Downside: Units affected by Retribution gain +2 to the Check.

<Suspension of Belief>.Effect: The moment your Mana drops to 0, freely cast Holy Grace (or an upgrade).
<Suspension of Belief>.Notes: Be wary of your faith, though, for gods seldom hold a positive outlook on those putting their conviction on hiatus.

<Culling Smite>.Effect:
After you roll for a melee attack, add 3d6 Divine Damage.
If the target does not die, refresh 1 Mana.
<Culling Smite>.Notes: Can not be used at the same time with other "Smite" Abilities.

<Lay on Hands>.Effect: Heal a Unit you can see for 50% of its Max Health.

~Magic Prison~.Effect:
Choose a Unit that has 10% or less Health.
You create a 4x4x4 meter magic cube from which that Unit physically can't walk through, no matter how hard they try.

~Resurrection~.Effect:
Touch a dead Unit, whose body is still in decent condition (as approved by the QM).
The dead Unit comes back to life, conscious and without Exhaustion, with 1 Health.

~Bravery Despite Fear~.Effect: Reset the Cooldown of a different Ability.

<Personal Squire>.Effect:
You recruit a squire - a trusted NPC who gains combat powers. However, the capabilities of your squire are random: roll 1d6 to determine the type of your squire, based on the Squires category at Pets and Animals (1. Bold, 2. Sneaky, 3. Clever, 4. Wise). The Race is determined by the QM or by circumstance.
On its turn, it can do one Pet Attack, cast one Ability it has, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Dash, Push, etc).
You can recruit one squire per Adventure, but only one can follow you in your adventures at a time.
At the start of every Adventure (and when you get this Talent), you must spend 1 Mana and train your Squire to permanently increase its Health by 2 or gain one Ability from any other Squire type.
<Personal Squire>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and heal it back to full Health.
<Personal Squire>.Notes: Your squire is not a Hero by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Hero can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

~Squire Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of the weapon's type, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Sprint, Push, etc).

<Harrowing Judgement>.Effect:
Choose a Unit with 50% or less Health.
A colossal spectral lance hits it and ^crushes it to death^.
<Harrowing Judgement>.Upgrade: Against Epic monsters, the threshold is 15% or less Health instead.
<Harrowing Judgement>.Note:
You always know if a Unit would die from this (ask the QM).
The Unit dies.

~Crimson Grace~.Requirement: Only usable in Worthy Combat. Can't be used on Fallen Units.
~Crimson Grace~.Effect:
~Deal 2 + Your Level Divine Damage to a Worthy Enemy.~
~An ally you see is healed for half of the Damage done.~

<Life Echo>.Effect:
You put a Life Echo on another ally.
Whenever YOU heal a different Unit, the Unit with the Life Echo on them is also healed for 50% of that amount.

<Divine Resurgence>.Effect: All other Heroes you healed this combat gain an extra Half-Action on their next turn.

<Asceticism>.Effect: For 1 minute, all Healing you do is increased by 50%, but all Damage you deal is reduced by 50%.

<Aspect of Ascension>.Effect:
You burst with angelic wings and burning vim.
Until the end of your next turn, you have 50% extra Movement and can fly, and can cast unlimited Abilities that cost Mana, ignoring the Mana cost and the limits of Faith Casting.
<Aspect of Ascension>.Upgrade: You can't use the same Basic Ability twice on the same turn.
<Aspect of Ascension>.Notes: E.g. let's say you used Smite last turn. This turn you activate Aspect of Ascension. You make a 1-Handed weapon attack, and add Smite to it as well. Next turn, you cast Solace Wave and Hand of Freedom, then make anther attack to which you add Smite. Then, you end your turn and Aspect of Ascension ends. You can now still cast Solace Wave and Hand of Freedom once.

<Legion of Oathsworn>.Effect:
In a place sanctified and pure, you start your own order of knights. Create a set of vows that your knights will abide to and have to recite to join you on your conquest.
You recruit a 3 beginner adventurer NPCs as squires! Each is one of the 4 possible squire types from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`: Bold, Sneaky, Clever or Wise, whichever makes fits better story-wise (or random). All your squires must be different types.
Passively, gain +2 in all Stats.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Upgrade: If your squire drops to 0 Health, it becomes Fallen, like a player. It has no Health Regen, but at any point outside of combat, you (the pet owner) can spend 30 minutes to tend to your squire's wounds and heal it back to full Health.
<Legion of Oathsworn>.Notes: Your squire is not a Hero by any means and does not behave like one (it can't use Weapons, Armor, Feats, Abilities, etc like a Hero can). It is limited to what its stat block and Abilities say it can do. You can, however, give it orders, customize its looks (hair style, clothes, etc) and it will obey your commands within reason. You are the leader it looks up to. Lead proudly and fairly!

~Squire Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of the weapon's type, or do the equivalent of a Half-Action (e.g. Sprint, Push, etc).

<March of the Chosen>.Effect:
Your entire party joins the crusade! All Heroes in your party have the Crusade Ability, the same Tier 1 Talent you have and access to the Divine Ability List.
Also, your entire party gains +1 Might and +1 Presence.

<Laying Waste>.Effect:
After you use Basic Ability that costs Mana with Faith Casting, reset the Cooldowns of all your Paladin Talents.
Passively, you gain +3 Might.
<Laying Waste>.Notes: Flaming Reach bonus Damage stacks with itself.

~Awe~.Effect:
After you spend Mana, "cast Awe" on a Unit for each Mana spent.
Casting Awe deals 1d4 Divine Damage if it's an Enemy, or Heals if it's an Ally.
~Awe~.Notes: Ignores Cover. Some other Cleric spells will "cast Awe" for free.

~Blessing~.Effect:
Cast Awe on 2 Units and they become Blessed.
Blessed Allies have +1 to all non-Combat Rolls for the rest of the Adventure. Blessed Enemies become Slowed.

~Saving Throw~.Effect:
Use when the Turn of an Enemy starts (or on your Turn).
Instantly pull another ally to your nearest empty space.
~Saving Throw~.Notes:
The ally goes flying.
You need line of sight to the targets. The allies fly to you ignoring obstacles and ground traps (goes around obstacles), unless the ally needs to swerve more than 2 meters in any direction.

~Mending~.Effect:
Touch a slightly broken piece of material that is still in one piece.
You can repair the Damage done to it.
Mending can repair a piece of Armor or Weapon for 1 Defense or Damage, but no more.
~Mending~.Notes: For example, repair a hole through a chain shirt or textile material, the crack in a piece of glass, etc.

~Mind's Thing~.Effect:
Deal 1d12 + ^Your Sense or Intelligence^ {Type} Damage to a Unit.
For the rest of the combat, whenever it would take {Type} Damage, it takes {Damage} more (stacks indefinitely).

~Click on the icon to selecte the preferred effect!~

~Solace Wave~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for 1d8 Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

~Elation~.Effect: Up to 2 Heroes you can see gain Health Regen equal to your Intelligence.

<Weakness of the Soul>.Effect: Cast Awe on a Unit. It becomes Slowed and Blinded. Apply a ~Combo~.

~Warding Incense~.Effect:
Use when an ally would take Damage.
Roll 1d6 and subtract that much from the attack.
Then give them the rolled die as one Shielding and apply a ~Combo~ on them.

~Radiant Smite~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack deals +1d6 Damage and all the Damage becomes Divine.
If the target dies, cast Awe.

~Herald of Radiance~.Effect:
Awe Damage and healing is 1d6 if you are at full Health.
You radiate light in a 3 meter radius.
~Herald of Radiance~.Notes: You can turn the light off at will.

~Herald of Twilight~.Effect:
Awe Damage and healing is 1d6 on targets at or below 50% Health.
You can see normally in the dark up to 5 meters away.

<Aspect>.Effect:
You take on a shadowy or illuminated appearance for the rest of the combat. Choose one:
{Diamond} Awe deals Scourge Damage. After you cast Awe, all your future Awe's deal +1 Damage. You can't heal (with anything).
{Diamond} After you heal someone, all your future heals heal for +1.

~Herald of the Moon~.Effect: If the Awe heals the target to Max Health, give them one Shielding that can block 1d4 Damage.

~Privilege~.Effect:
Heal a Hero you can see for an amount equal to their Health Regen.
They do not Regen Health at the end of the Combat.
~Privilege~.Combo: They can Regen Health after Combat, but only for 50% of Health Regen.

~Second Light~.Effect:
A shining light bursts onto a Unit, dealing 2d8 + ^Sense^ {Type} Damage to it.
The next time somoene rolls dice that affect that Unit, the roller can reroll each die of that Act they choose once.
~Second Light~.Notes: The roller can rereoll them even if it was an area effect or another effect that affected multiple Units.

~Deafening Silence~.Effect: A Unit you can see takes 3d8 Psychic Damage and is Deafened.

~Reveling Rays~.Effect:
You shoot out 10 rays of light.
Roll 10d4 and assign them to Units within 10 meters as you with.
Each die heals on odd rolls (1 and 3) and deals Divine Damage on even rolls (2 and 4).

~Let There Be Light~.Effect: While standing in natural light (e.g. the sun), your Healing Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and you are immune to being Silenced.
~Let There Be Light~.Notes: {DiceUpgrade}. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered natural light.

<Let There Be Darkness>.Effect: While standing in environmental shadows, your damaging Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type and your attacks ignore Cover.
<Let There Be Darkness>.Notes: {DiceUpgrade}. It is up to the Quest Master what is considered shadow.

~Assistance of Merit~.Effect: Whenever you use a Reaction, cast Awe or Single-Stun a Unit.

<Circle of Awe>.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area. Cast Awe on all Units inside the area.
After casting Awe 3 times, reset the Cooldown of this Ability (except Awes from this Ability).

~Solace Tide~.Effect:
Heal an ally (or yourself) for ~1d10~ Health.
If they have 50% or more Health before the heal, double the result!

<Shadow Realm>.Effect:
A Unit becomes trapped in a Shadow Realm with you for 2 rounds (this and the next).
Your attacks cast Awe on it for free while inside the Shadow Realm.
<Shadow Realm>.Upgrade:
Neither of you can interact with the outside world, but can feintly see it.
Units on the outside can faintly see the two of you, as if you were ghosts.
The trapping ends immediately if you Fall.
<Shadow Realm>.Notes: The Shadow Realm is a copy of the normal world, but with no other units.

<Black Hole>.Effect:
Choose a point as the center of a Black Hole.
At the end of each Round, Slam* all Units within 6 meters of the Black Hole towards the center.
When one comes within 1 meter of the center, cast Awe on it and it becomes Slowed.
<Black Hole>.Upgrade: Only Units that meet in the center take Damage from the Slam. Each takes Damage equal to their own distance thrown (if they slam into eachother).
<Black Hole>.Notes: If Units are Slammed into other things, they take Damage as normal.

~Water Walk~.Effect:
Up to 2 willing Units can walk on water as normally.
The effect ends if the Unit takes Damage.

~People's Awe~.Effect: Awe now hits all Units in a 2x2 area, but can't heal yourself and requires being in Worthy Combat.

<Maiming Dark>.Effect:
Triple-Stun a Unit and Single-Stunn another willing ally (not you). Then cast Awe on each.
These Units' Passive Abilities are disabled while affected.

<Healing Doubledown>.Effect: Until the end of your next turn, double all healing you and your party does.
<Healing Doubledown>.Notes: Doesn't stack with other healing multiplication effects.

<Inedianism>.Effect:
Whenever you cast a 0 Actions Class Ability or Talent, another ally gains 1 Mana.
Also, you don't need to eat or drink to live - you only need exposure to light.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +5)
<Stat Bonus 5>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Mana Bonus>.Effect: Gain +1 Max Mana and +1 Known Ability.

<Edict of Awe Eternal>.Effect:
~Cast Awe twice. The dice results are increased by 50%.~
This deals 1d4 Divine Damage to enemies or heals allies for 1d4.
Passively, your Intelligence and Sense increase by 2 and you can effortlessly levitate up to 1 meter above the ground, water etc. and don't take fall Damage.

<Miracle>.Effect:
You pray with divine confidence and purpose, and, with the gods' will, you manifest your wish upon your mortal world.
Choose one of the following effects to manifest:
{Diamond} Manifest restoration: Choose a person you can touch to instantly and fully kill, resurrect or heal them, restore their body parts, injuries or handicaps, change their race, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest materialism: Create an object worth up to 5000 {Gold}Gold and make it appear out of thin air in a beacon of blinding light. Or choose an object or area worth that much and make it disappear; Units with their materialistic value worth a total of 5000 {Gold} or less also disappear.
{Diamond} Manifest fate: Determine or read the near future of one Unit.
{Diamond} Manifest mistake: Undo a recent past event that was not a Worthy Combat. You and your party remains in the present to witness the aftermath.
{Diamond} Manifest destruction: Deal 2d100 Scourge Damage spread (after rolling) as you like among Units within 10 meters.
{Diamond} Manifest development: Choose a Unit and increase up to 2 of their Stats by 1, or they permanently learn a new Basic Ability, etc.
{Diamond} Manifest creativity: Choose something else with a similar scope to do, if the gods will.
After casting Miracle, if the gods will, the Cooldown of Miracle may be reset if they deem the effect was not worthy enough.
<Miracle>.Notes: The gods' will is determined by the Quest Master. Talk to the QM about your possibilities.

~Ambush~.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals +1d8 Damage.
~Ambush~.Upgrade: At Level 2, your Specialization will greatly improve your Ambush.

~Stalking~.Effect: On the first Round of Combat, you can start your Turn whenever you like (even during other Units' turns), and make a free Move Act.
~Stalking~.Notes: If you want to start during an enemy's Turn, you do so when they declare they want to do something or after they finish doing something.

~Roguish Talents~.Effect: As a Rogue, you only have Minor Talents at Level 1 and the rest of your Talents are Keystone Talents (except Utility Talents).

~Bells and Whistles~.Effect:
You setup an invisible 6x6x6 meter area.
If an unknown Unit or Enemy enters the cube, you are immediately alerted and woken up.
While inside the area, ^YOU^ cannot be Surprised.

~Gladiator Grandeur~.Effect: Push a Worthy Enemy 1 meter in any direction. Gain {Gold}Gold equal to the enemy's Experience Worth.
~Gladiator Grandeur~.Upgrade: Epic Monsters award {Gold}Gold equal to their Experience Worth / Epic Grade.

~Lockpicking~.Effect: While you have this Talent you have +3 in Lockpicking, may attempt each Lockpicking Roll again if you fail, and rolling Events on Lockpicking does nothing.

~Creeping Ambush~.Effect: Insted of dealing Damage to the same target with Ambush, you can deal it to another Unit you can see.

~Knife Throw~.Effect: Your next melee 1-handed weapon attack has a 4 meter range.

~Parry~.Effect: Your next attack deals -50% Damage, but gives an ally you can see one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.

~Fool's Gold~.Effect: After you Ambush, gain {Gold}Gold equal to all the Damage done by the attack.
~Fool's Gold~.Notes: Lore-wise, as a Thief, you prepare and build up momentum in combat. When you reach a town, you put your preparations in motion and gain the gold. Feel free to them

~Backstabbing Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first weapon attack deals +1d6 Damage ~if there is an ally of yours near the target~.

~Icebreaker Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first weapon attack deals +1d10 Damage ~if the target is at full Health~.

~Thief's Ambush~.Effect:
Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals ~+2d8~ Damage ~and applies a Combo~.
~Gain~ {Gold}~Gold equal to the ambushed amount.~

<Magic Trickster>.Effect:
You have 2 Mana that replenishes inbetween Adventures and gain access to one `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` of choice.
When you get this Talent, you can pick 2 Magic Font Minor Talents to Know, and can get more as you would normally get extra Minor Talents.

<Verge of the Coin>.Effect: Whenever YOU would Damage an Enemy leaving it at 10% Health or below, it dies, and you gain {Gold}Gold equal to its Maximum Health.

~Shade Bend~.Effect:
Choose a shadow you can see.
You can manipulate the shape of this shadow and even extend it upward to attack for 1d6 and Deafen the target.
~Shade Bend~.Upgrade: This attack is able to trigger Ambush.

~Ghost Strike~.Effect: When you Ambush, also deal 50% of the Ambush Damage to another Unit within 3 meters of the main target.
~Ghost Strike~.Notes: Refers, for example, to the extra 1d8, not the entire attack's Damage.

<Hide In Plain Sight>.Effect:
When Combat starts, you can start on any visible edge of the battlefield.
The first time you deal Damage each Combat, you can choose to reroll any of the rolled dice.
<Hide In Plain Sight>.Notes: You know the ins and outs of battlefields so well that you successfully reposition before anyone else notices.

<Bounty Appraisal>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, the Quest Master determines which is the most powerful enemy.
When that enemy dies, heal an ally for 1d10 and gain {Gold}Gold equal to 1000% of the amount healed.

~Slowing Poison~.Effect:
Your weapons are coated in a potent poison.
Your first weapon attack on each Unit with 50% or less Health deals +1d4 Poison Damage and Slows it.

<Magestep>.Effect:
Teleport up to 3 meters away.
Your next attack applies your Ambush if it wouldn't normally, and all the Damage becomes Fire, Cold or Shock (your choice).
<Magestep>.Downside: Doesn't work with Thief's Ambush or Sudden Ambush. The attack can Ambush even if it's the second time this Turn (or further).

<Trap Wires>.Effect:
When combat starts, deploy a number of Trap Wires equal to ^your Intelligence or Charisma^, anywhere on the battlefield.
A Trap Wire is thin and up to 3 meters long, and must be deployed between 2 obstacles.
Units with less than 3 Sense can't see the Trap Wires.
