If a Unit touches a Trap Wire, it takes 1d10 Shock damage and becomes Dazed.
<Trap Wires>.Notes:
Each end of the wire must be attached to something solid and static.
You can make use of walls, obstacles, etc.
Requires a Special Tripwire Set item, which can be bought for 100 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).

<Blade Tempest>.Effect:
Throw 8 shurikens: one towards each direction (north, north-east, east, south, etc).
Each shuriken travels 4 meters, deals 2d6 Slash Damage to all Units it passes through, then stops in place.
At the end of your next turn, each shuriken returns to you, dealing 2d6 Slash Damage again to all Units it passes through.
<Blade Tempest>.Notes: Requires 8 Special Shuriken items, which can be bought for a total of 120 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials). If you're playing on a Grid, take semi-hitting into account for blades that don't travel squares exactly in the 8 directions. Cover applies normally to each blade.

<Moneycraft>.Effect: Spend 400 {Gold}Gold to permanently improve a piece of equipment. Depending on its type (armor or weapon), roll on the table below to determine the effect you get.
<Moneycraft>.Upgrade: A piece of equipment can be improved any number of times, but every extra improvement costs twice as much as its previous improvement.

<Gold Hoard>.Effect: You gain various bonuses based on how much gold you are carrying.

Values: +10% gold that YOU find and get from Abilities

<Finders Keepers>.Effect: When looting a _lootable object_ that _contains Worthy items_, you can spend any amount of gold to also loot an item worth up to twice the spent amount.
<Finders Keepers>.Notes: It is up to the Quest Master what a _lootable object_ is (could be a chest, the corpse of an enemy, etc). Also, it is up to the Quest Master what _Worthy items_ means (could be main quest items, magic items, or just a normal chest).

<Draw Steel>.Effect: Refresh all your other Cooldowns, Ambushes, and retrigger any _start of Combat_ effects from your Abilities.
<Draw Steel>.Notes: Refreshing an Ambush means you can use it again this Turn if you already used it.

<Minor Golden Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush, spend 10% of your carried total {Gold}Gold (minimum 100) to add +1d8 Damage.
<Minor Golden Ambush>.Notes: You need to have this gold on you.

<Minor Savage Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush, if the target also has 50% or less Health (before your attack's Damage), the attack deals +1d6 Damage.

<Minor Icebreaker Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush a Unit that has full Health, the attack deals +1d6 Damage.

<Minor Isolated Ambush>.Effect: When you Ambush a Unit, if there are no other Units within 1 meter of it (except you), the attack deals +1d6 Damage.

<Spellkill>.Effect: After you Ambush, your next 1-Mana Spell this Turn costs no Mana.

<Sharp Toss>.Effect: This turn, whenever you do an Act, flick a throwable and deal 2 Pierce Damage to a Unit.
<Sharp Toss>.Notes: Can flick needles, small knives, shuriken, etc. Sharp Toss, when cast and when thrown, is not considered an Act.

<Shadowpass>.Effect: Choose a point covered in shadow up to 6 meters away and teleport to it.
<Shadowpass>.Upgrade: You can use this as a Reaction when an enemy wants to attack you (before dealing the Damage). If it can't do the attack anymore, it must choose something else to do.

~Isolated Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first ~attack or single-target offensive Ability against an isolated Unit~ deals +1d8 Damage.
~Isolated Ambush~.Notes: A Unit is _isolated_ if there are no other Units (except you) within 1 meter of it.

~Sudden Ambush~.Effect:
Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals ~+3d6~ Damage.
~If you end a Turn without having dealt Damage, reset this.~

~Savage Ambush~.Effect: Every ~Turn~, your first ~attack or single-target offensive Ability against a Unit with 50% or less Health~ deals +1d10 Damage.

<Practice Makes Lethal>.Effect:
Whenever YOU kill a Worthy Enemy, gain a ^Practice Makes Lethal^ point.
While you have this Talent, your first Damaging Attack or Ability every Worthy Combat deals extra Damage equal to your ^Practice Makes Lethal^ points.

<Enveloping Shadows>.Effect:
Immediately before or after you Shadowpass (your choice), all Units within 1 meter from you become Blinded.
Your next attack deals +1d4 Damage.

<Critical Doubledown>.Effect:
When you ^Critical Strike^, the ^Critical Strike^ effect happens twice.
If a weapon can't do a ^Critical Strike^, it also has the following effect:
<Critical Doubledown>.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - If you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal +1 Damage if one-handed (+1d4 if two-handed).
<Critical Doubledown>.Upgrade: Note that the additional (green) Critical Strike is also doubled!

<One Turn Kill>.Effect: Whenever you take a Worthy Enemy from 50% (or more) to 0% Health in one Turn, heal for 1d8 and reset all your Cooldowns.

<Cutting Verve>.Effect: After you Ambush, you can choose one of the rolled dice and give it to an ally you can see (or yourself) as a Shielding after dealing the Damage.

<Isolation>.Effect: When Ambushing a Unit, if there is no other Unit near it (except you), the target becomes Dazed.

<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Effect:
Choose a point covered in shadow up to 6 meters away and teleport to it.
~Your next attack within 1 minute makes the attack's target roll a Might Check against the Damage done. If it fails, it becomes put to Sleep for 1 minute.~
<Take-Out Shadowpass>.Upgrade:
You can use this as a Reaction when an enemy wants to attack you (before dealing the Damage). If it can't do the attack anymore, it must choose something else to do.
~Epic monsters are instead Triple-Stunned for 1 Turn.~

<Shadow Maw>.Effect:
Open a 5x5 meter maw of shadows on the ground.
All Units caught take 3d6 Psychic Damage.
The shadow maw is completely dark and disorientig - if a Unit starts its Turn in the maw, it must begin by making a Move Act in a random direction.
<Shadow Maw>.Upgrade: Single-target attacks have no line of sight from, to and through the maw, and everything else has Cover.

<Planned Assassination>.Effect:
Name a specific Epic Unit, or a non-Epic Unit type.
Next Combat, your Ambushes deal +100% Damage against the named Unit or Unit Type.

<Blade Verge>.Effect: Whenever YOU would Damage an Enemy leaving it at 10% Health or below, it dies, and you can instantly Shadowpass now regardless of its Cooldown.

<Shadowlayers>.Requirement: Only usable until the end of the next Turn after you Shadowpass
<Shadowlayers>.Effect: Immediately Shadowpass back to where you last Shadowpassed from (to the original position from which you Shadowpassed), then become invisible until the start of your next Turn (or for 6 seconds). Also, passively, you can use Shadowpass to teleport an ally instead of yourself.
<Shadowlayers>.Notes: This special Shadowpass doesn't retrigger Shadowlayers, but is improved by any Shadowpass upgrades and effects you have.

<Ambushing Shadowpass>.Effect: After you Shadowpass, your first Damaging Attack or Spell that turn deals +1d6 Damage.

<Finale>.Effect: For each attack, Ability and application of Ambush you made this turn, deal 1d10 Damage that ignores all Shielding and Damage Reductions.

<Coup de Grace>.Effect:
Whenever you Ambush a Worthy Enemy, roll a Dexterity Check at least equal to ^target's total Stats sum^ to increase the Ambush dice Damage by 50%.
If you fail, your next Check this Adventure increases by 50%.

~Echoes~.Effect:
After you cast a Basic Ability, roll 1d8.
If you rolled 8 on it, the Ability _echoes_ and you cast it again (for 0 Actions), but ^all^ Damage or Healing it does is reduced by 50%.
The _echoed_ Ability can't affect the same target(s) or area.
~Echoes~.Notes:
Abilities like Recuperate can't _echo_, since the only possible target is yourself.
If the area overlaps the initial area, the overlapped part has no effect. If it hits the same target(s), it has no effect on them.
Take the Ability text as it is - _echoing_ Lightning Storm repeats the initial Damage, but you'd have to spend another 1 Action to retrigger the second Lightning Storm.
The QM has the word on whether something is possible.

~Link Minds~.Effect:
Establish a mind connection with a willing ally.
For the rest of the Adventure, you can talk to eachother telepathically.
~Link Minds~.Notes: You can only have one Intelligence Linked ally at a time.

~Dispel Magic~.Effect: Dispell all ongoing _non-chronic_ magical effects on a Unit (any magical Crowd Control, magical buffs and debuffs, etc).
~Dispel Magic~.Notes: Chronic effects are ones that last days, months or are permanent, such as curses, vampirism, etc.

~Blood and Salt~.Effect: Until the start of your next turn, you take -1d4 Damage from all sources.

<Incorporeal Form>.Effect:
You become a bodyless soul for up to 8 hours and enter a willing ally.
While inside the ally's body, you can communicate with them mentally, and only they can see you.
You can slightly peek outside of their body, and move your arms, upper body and head as if you were a ghost originating from that ally's body.
{Diamond} You can't move yourself, but you always move with that ally.
{Diamond} You can't do any physical actions (because you are a ghost and can't touch anything or anyone).
{Diamond} You can cast spells normally. 
{Diamond} You follow your own Initiative in combat.
{Diamond} You can't take Damage or Crowd Control from external sources, but you feel every body sensation that ally feels.
You can freely exit their body and revert back to your physical self using 0 Actions.

<Dream Walk>.Effect:
Make a Sense Check against another non-Epic Unit's Sense Check. If you succeed, it falls Asleep for 2 turns.
Alternatively, you can use Dream Walk on an already sleeping target to alter their dreams to your liking.
<Dream Walk>.Notes: A Sleeping Unit wakes up if it takes Damage or other Crowd Control.

<Enlightening Ritual>.Effect:
You undergo an isolated, personal and mind-altering ritual with a willing non-Warlock Hero at a campfire, and using incense, smoke and special herbs.
The ally must make a Sense Check against 6 + Your Sense.
If it succeeds, its Max Mana permanently increases by 1, and gets +2 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
If it fails, it takes 1d8 Psychic Damage and gets -1 to all Checks for the rest of the Adventure.
<Enlightening Ritual>.Upgrade:
You can perform this ritual as many times as you want per Adventure until you succeed once. It costs you 1 Mana (not Max Mana), which is spent when the ally passes the ritual.
A person can only succeed one Enlightening Ritual in their lifetime.
Respeccing keeps the effects for your Ally.

<Rainmaking>.Effect:
Perform a ritual to change the weather or atmosphere on a 100 meter area (in diameter) centered on you.
Choose one option from Storm, Wind, Heat, Cold.
<Rainmaking>.Notes: In dungeons and indoors, this only goes through open doors and spaces - the weather starts from you and extends as much as possible through open holes, windows, doors, etc.

Values: Your team deals 2 extra Damage with all Spells
Your team has +1 Movement Speed, +1 Damage with missiles and can freely jump 5 meters (using Movement)
Your team deals 2 extra Damage with physical weapons

<Psyche Tether>.Effect:
Place a tether on 2 Units within 10 meters of you.
The next time one of them is Damaged or Healed, the other one takes the Damage (as Psychic Damage) or Healing as well.
<Psyche Tether>.Notes:
If both are Damaged/Healed at the same time, this only applies once and you choose which takes the Damage/Healing of the other.
The extra Damage of Smites, Ambush, etc over an attack counts as the same Damage source.

~Sending~.Effect: Send a message no longer than 5 seconds long to an ally, wherever it is. It can include images, sounds and smells. That ally knows they received a message from you.
~Sending~.Upgrade: Requires you to be holding something physical from that ally, such as a piece of clothing, an object, a strand of hair, etc.
~Sending~.Notes: Sending might be impeded if sent to another plane/world.

~Telekinesis~.Effect:
For the next 1 minute, while channeling, you can manipulate objects 10 meters away from you as if used by your own hand.
You can also zoom in on your vision, hearing and smelling up to 10 meters away.

<Synchronicity>.Effect: Your _echo_ dice become 2d8 (instead of 1d8). Each rolled 8 makes the Ability Echo.

<Reincarnation>.Effect:
Use when you or an ally you can see Falls or dies. Choose an animal from the Pets and Animals list.
They immediately come to life as a translucent spirit version of that Animal.
Lasts until the ally Rises (or the animal dies too).
<Reincarnation>.Upgrade: The ally can do Animal Attack (Druid), which does 1d6 + ^their Sense^ Damage (for a Half-Action).

~Unstable Spark~.Effect:
At the start of your every Turn in a Worthy Combat, roll 1d10.
If you roll 1, you take 1d6 True Damage.
If you roll 10, your next Spell this Turn has +50% Damage.

~Flux~.Effect: Choose a Damage Type from the ones listed below. That becomes your {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Type. Some of your Spells's Damage deal that Damage Type (written explicitly on those Spells).
~Flux~.Upgrade: 1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.

~Poetic Justice~.Effect:
At any point where it's fit, you can call for a _poetic justice moment_, representing a living metaphor, turning a situation around, karma, irony, or coming full circle.
In the next 10 real minutes, an event may happen that can be interpreted as _poetic justice_, which could be either good or bad for your team.
The Quest Master may fumble one die roll or alter the current situation so that it reflects a _poetic moment_.
~Poetic Justice~.Upgrade: There may be no place for poetic justice at that time, and it's possible nothing happens as the result of this.
~Poetic Justice~.Notes: They can be events such as being saved by your worst enemy, or a xenophobic person being discriminated against by someone else who is xenophobic. Or perhaps a goblin dies by an arrow to the kn-, I mean shoulder, after he launched an arrow in someone else's shoulder.

~Fracture Reality~.Effect: Lightly alter reality to change a small detail in a story or environment that does not have large consequences. All other characters believe it didn't change, and it's always been like that.
~Fracture Reality~.Upgrade: This may not be the right time to fracture reality, and it's possible your request does not happen.
~Fracture Reality~.Notes: They can be _Mandela effect_ events such as changing the color of an object, a character placing something in a different room, you having bought a certain item that you didn't buy. Ask the Quest Master if your request fits!

~Flash~.Effect: Instantly teleport up to 5 meters away, within line of sight.
~Flash~.Notes: Does not work if you're Rooted or stuck in place somehow. You take with you all items carried you want, but not other Units.

~Magic Tricks~.Effect:
Choose one of these effects to cast:
{Diamond} Create harmless sensory effects, sparks or non-damaging heat or cold.
{Diamond} Channel to create simple, small, harmless illusions in your hand or within 3 meters.
{Diamond} Instantly clean or soil objects.
{Diamond} Control a quill with telekinesis to quickly write with it.

~Chaos Storm~.Effect:
Roll an Unstable Spark die (and apply its effect if any).
Deal that much Damage of that Damage Type to exactly that many Worthy Units you can see.
~Chaos Storm~.Notes:
Roll for a random Damage type from the following: 1. Pierce, 2. Slash, 3. Pulse, 4. Poison, 5. Acid, 6. Divine, 7. Scourge, 8. Shock, 9. Cold, 10. Fire.
Targeting Worthy Units is mandatory, and you count as a Worthy Unit.
If your Unstable Spark is higher than 10, you can choose the Damage Type.

~Jolt~.Effect:
Shoot a quick burst of current at a Unit, dealing 1d6 + ^Any Stat^ {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage.
Then roll an Unstable Spark die.
~Jolt~.Downside: Only usable if your last Unstable Spark die rolled was at least 6.

~Gathering the Magic~.Effect: For the rest of the Combat, whenever you roll 3 on the Unstable Spark die, gain +1 Skill Point permanently.

~Soulflare~.Effect:
Deal {Amount} {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage to {ToWhat}.

~You have access to all Variants of this Spell (click on the icon to select the preferred effect)!~

~Arcane Fire~.Effect: Your next weapon attack until the end of your next Turn deals extra Damage equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die and all its Damage dealt becomes {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage.

~Spellbloodweave~.Effect: Use after you make an attack or use an offensive Ability. It deals -50% Damage, but instead heals an ally you can see for the final Damage dealt.

<Wild Casting>.Effect:
When you roll the Unstable Spark die, if you roll 1 or 2, roll 1d20 (after taking Damage on 1). The Quest Master freely casts that Spell from the table below.
If you rolled 2 on the Unstable Spark die, the effect is negative for your team. Otherwise, it's positive.
The lower Health you are, the more intense the effect (probably).
<Wild Casting>.Notes:
For example, if you roll 1 and the random Spell is Fire Enchantment, it will be cast on an enemy's weapon if possible (respecting the range). If not possible, then it will be cast on a random, non-Hero's weapon. If not possible, then it will be cast on a Hero's weapon. If nothing is possible, nothing happens.
If an effect can be cancelled or has ongoing effects, you have control of them as if you yourself had cast the Spell.

SpellTable.Name: 1. Fake Sound
SpellTable.Effect: A sound is magically created at a point (it can Deafen some Units).

SpellTable.Name: 2. Quicksand
SpellTable.Effect: An 3x3 to 9x9 area becomes Hard Terrain.

SpellTable.Name: 3. Conjure Steed
SpellTable.Effect: A random animal is conjured as a mount for 1 to 5 Units.

SpellTable.Name: 4. Force Wall
SpellTable.Effect: A thin 2x2 to 6x6 transparent wall is created.

SpellTable.Name: 5. Obstable Break
SpellTable.Effect: One or more obstacles or traps are destroyed.

SpellTable.Name: 6. Strange Wave
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are Healed or Damaged for 1d4.

SpellTable.Name: 7. Teleportation
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units are teleported 1 to 10 meters.

SpellTable.Name: 8. Fog
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 fog cloud is created.

SpellTable.Name: 9. Enchanted Weapons
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units have their weapons enchanted (+2 Damage, any element)

SpellTable.Name: 10. Invisibility
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 Units become invisible for 1 to 99 Turns.

SpellTable.Name: 11. FULMINATION
SpellTable.Effect: A 3x3 to 9x9 explosion happens, dealing 2d6 to 6d6 Damage of any element.

SpellTable.Name: 12. Fling
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 5 objects or items are flung around. If any hits a Unit, deals 1d6 Damage.

SpellTable.Name: 13. Thunder Clap
SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 to 6 meters of you take 1d6 to 3d6 Damage (any type).

SpellTable.Name: 14. Wilder Casting
SpellTable.Effect: Roll 2 more times on this table.

SpellTable.Name: 15. Reverse Gravity
SpellTable.Effect: The gravity in a 3x3x3 to 9x9x9 area is reversed.

SpellTable.Name: 16. Banish
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units are banished to another plane for 1 Turn. When they come back, they immediately take 1 Turn.

SpellTable.Name: 17. Unknowable Health
SpellTable.Effect: A Unit is healed for 5 to 55 Health.

SpellTable.Name: 18. Lightning Strikes Again
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 Units get any Crowd Control.

SpellTable.Name: 19. Nervous System Jolt
SpellTable.Effect: One Unit permanently gains +1 in a Stat, or +1 to +3 Max Health, Regen or Mana.

SpellTable.Name: 20. Resurrection
SpellTable.Effect: 1 to 3 dead or Fallen Units come back to life (without Exhaustion) with 1 to full Health.

<Guiled Casting>.Effect: When you roll 2 on the Unstable Spark die, after taking the Damage, you deal +1 Damage of a random Damage Type _permanently_ as long as you have this Talent.
<Guiled Casting>.Notes: 1. Fire, 2. Cold, 3. Shock, 4. Pulse, 5. Poison, 6. Acid, 7. Divine, 8. Scourge.

<Mild Casting>.Effect:
Your base Unstable Spark also triggers on 9.
After you cast a Spell or one of its variants, you can't cast that spell or variant again this Combat.
<Mild Casting>.Notes: If you cast the 1st version Soulflare, you can still cast its other versions this Combat.

<Viled Casting>.Effect: All non-physical Damage you deal becomes Eldritch Damage. When you roll 2 on the Unstable Spark die, increase all Eldritch Damage you deal for the rest of the combat by 3. Then roll another Unstable Spark die.

<Sap>.Effect:
A Unit must make a Charisma Roll at least equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die or be Deafened, Slowed or Dazed (your choice).
If it passes, roll an Unstable Spark die.
<Sap>.Notes: What are you doing, just pick Wild Casting.

~Throwback~.Effect: Get one more Level 2 Keystone Talent.

<Second Try>.Effect: Use after you roll an Unstable Spark die. You may cancel the roll. Then roll 2 more.

<Arcano Mantissa>.Effect: When you roll 4 on the Unstable Spark die, gain 0.5 Max Health and 0.25 Max Mana.
<Arcano Mantissa>.Notes: Mana and Health can't be expended or Damaged in fractions, but if you manage to get this 2 times, you essentially get +1 Health permanently (or 1 Mana permanently if you trigger this 4 times).

<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Effect: Your Unstable Spark die becomes 1d12 instead of 1d10, and triggers on 11 and 12 instead of 10.
<Honorificabilitudinitatibus>.Notes: I don't know. You're a Sorcerer, figure it out.

<Tap>.Effect: When you roll 4 on the Unstable Spark die, deal 1d4 {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage. It gets affected by that effect:

~Font Magic~.Effect:
You may select a `Magic Font$/Other/MagicFonts` to pick Minor Talents from.
You get a free Magic Font Minor Talent.
Gain +1 Intelligence (up to +4).
~Font Magic~.Notes:
All Magic Font Abilities are Minor Talents.
You can get more Magic Font Minor Talents as if you're getting normal Minor Talents (e.g. a number of them equal to your Intellgience).

~Will You Just Die~.Effect:
Use when you drop to or below 0 Health.
You can go into debt with Health, down to 50% of your Max Health.
~Will You Just Die~.Upgrade: At the end of the Combat, if you are at or below 0 Health, you become Fallen and unconscious, and you keep your Health Debt until you are healed to 1 or more Health. Heal to recover Health debt!

~Spiritflare~.Effect:
Deal {Amount} {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage to {ToWhat}.

~You have access to all Variants of this Spell (click on the icon to select the preferred effect)!~
~Spiritflare~.Notes: ~The Damage is higher than the regular Soulflare.~

<Star Burst>.Effect:
Declare up to 4 different targets you can see.
Assign a different number from #1 to #4 to each.
Roll a number of d4's equal to your last rolled Unstable Spark die. Each d4 rolled deals that much Pulse Damage to the target with that number.
Each rolled 1 deals 1 Damage to target number #1, each rolled 2 deals 2 Damage to target number #2, and so on.
<Star Burst>.Notes:
E.g. if you put #2 on a goblin, and you roll three 2's on the d4's, then that goblin takes 6 Pulse Damage.
You should probably assign the higher number to the target you want to do most Damage to.
You can declare fewer targets, but then the missing number will deal Damage to no target.
Cover is applied normally.

~Arc Jolt~.Effect:
Shoot a quick burst of current at a Unit, dealing ~1d10~ + ^Any Stat^ {Color('orange', 'Flux')} Damage.
Then roll an Unstable Spark die.
~Arc Jolt~.Downside: Only usable if your last Unstable Spark die rolled was at least 6.

~Reverse Gravity~.Effect:
Declare an area with a diameter in meters (in all directions) equal to your Level.
The gravity becomes reversed in that area and all Units instantly fall upwards. Units can make a Dexterity Check to grab onto an object to not be lifted.
Units suffer fall Damage if they fall onto a ceiling.
When the effect ends, all Units fall at half velocity (and take half of the fall Damage). The same happens to a Unit if it exits the area.
Lasts for up to 1 minute. You can cancel this effect at will.
~Reverse Gravity~.Notes: Fall Damage is 1d6 for every 2 meters fallen (e.g. 1d6 for 2 and 3 meters, 2d6 for 4 and 5 meters, etc).

~Hearth Recall~.Effect:
You can spend 10 minutes in a place to Bind to it.
When you use this Ability, channel for 10 minutes to teleport up to 1d6 Allies (and yourself) within 10 meters of you to the bound place.
You can only have 1 bound place at a time.
~Hearth Recall~.EffectRed: You can teleport more Allies than the rolled die, but the teleportation will have strange side effects or consequences.
~Hearth Recall~.Notes: You can remove the binding of a place at will, from any distance.

<Great Sorcery>.Effect: When you roll 8 or 9 on the Unstable Spark die, gain 1 Mana.

<Zap>.Effect: When you roll 6, 7 or 8 on the Unstable Spark die, immediately Zap the closest Unit to you for ^your Intelligence^ Shock Damage.

<Chronomancy>.Effect:
Instantly return to how and where you were at the start of the turn, with that same Movement, Actions, Health, Shielding, Buffs and Cooldowns (not Mana, though).
Alternatively, if you're out of combat, you can turn back time for all the world up to 10 minutes, exactly how it was, but retaining all your information from the future. Allies don't retain the information.

<Double Spark Triple Quark>.Effect: Whenever you would roll an Unstable Spark die, roll 2 instead of one. Apply effects for both.

<Grand Sorcery>.Effect:
Arcane power flows potently through your veins! Whenever you would roll one or more Unstable Spark dice, roll 3 more.
Whenever you would roll dice for a Spell, all the dice are a baseline d10, no matter what die type it is (can still have ^Dice Upgraded^).
<Grand Sorcery>.Upgrade: Your appearance changes to reflect your sorcerer powers, resulting in glowing eyes, or your hair resembling a particular element, like fire or electricity.

<Locus of Control>.Effect:
You gain control over your own magic, and, whenever you would roll an Unstable Spark die, you can instead choose the number. In fact, whenever you roll one or more dice for a Spell, instead of rolling half of them, you can even choose the numbers.
Screw it, once per Round, when someone else would roll a die, just name what number you want and it happens!
<Locus of Control>.Upgrade: The control over magic reflects in your physical appearance, resulting in effects such as contracted pupils, uncannily smooth body and hair, or an uncoventionally toned voice.

<Draconianism>.Effect:
Your natural form changes to that of a large, winged dragon. Your base Maximum Mana increases by 10 and your base Max Health by 50%. You can fly at your normal Speed.
You must choose what color you are as a dragon. As your breath attack, you can cast any Basic Ability that deals Damage and doesn't cost Mana, and it also hits all Units within 2 meters of the main target. You also take -50% Damage from the Damage Type of your chosen Ability.
<Draconianism>.Upgrade: You can transform into your person-self at will, but, to you, your dragon form is more comfortable.

~Second Soul~.Effect:
You have another Unit beside you that you control which is essentially another Hero.
Your companion is built like a normal Level 1 Hero, but all its stats are decreased by 1, starts with no separate Gold and can not gain Feats.
It always has the same Initiative as you and Levels Up only when you Level Up (doesn't have personal Experience).
~Second Soul~.Upgrade: For the Quest Masters, your companion counts as a normal Hero for encounter Experience!
~Second Soul~.Notes: Come up with a story about why you have your companion and why your god allowed this or gave them to you.

~Partner in Life~.Effect:
Your companion is an alive being. It can be a sentient person of any race, except Hollow.
This companion's soul is tied to yours and viceversa - when one of you dies, the other dies as well.
Both of you gain +3 Health Regen.

~True Necromancy~.Effect:
Your companion is an undead. It can be a sentient undead person of any race (without affecting its stats) or an abstract undead creature using any race's Abilities.
This companion's life depends on yours - when you die, your companion dies as well.
Your companion takes -50% Slashing and Scourge Damage.
~True Necromancy~.Notes: If your companion dies, you can spend 1 week to "revive" someone else as your new companion.

~Guardian Angel~.Effect:
Your companion is an otherworldly celestial in material form. It can be a sentient person of any race, or an abstrat celestial creature using any race's Abilities.
Your life is tied to your companion's - when it dies, you die.
You share the your Health pool with your companion (it does not have separate separate Health). If it goes more than 10 meters away from you, it is teleported near you immediately.
You gain +10 Maximum Health.

<Blessing of Life>.Effect:
Cast Awe ~twice~ and the target(s) becomes Blessed until the end of the next (or current) Combat.
Blessed Allies have +1 to all Checks ~and +1 to all Damage instances~. Blessed Enemies have -3 Initiative ~and -1 to all Damage instances~.
<Blessing of Life>.Upgrade: On Epic Monsters, the -1 Damage only affects their first turn.
<Blessing of Life>.Notes:
You can bless yourself.
Lasts until the end of the next combat encounter.

~Awe For Corpses~.Effect:
Whenever you spend Mana, "cast Awe" on a Unit.
This deals 1d4 Divine Damage to enemies or heals allies for 1d4.
~However, if there is any nearby corpse within 5 meters when you would cast Awe, you instead raise a zombie to fight for you from that corpse.~
~Awe For Corpses~.Notes: Ignores Cover. Some other Cleric spells will "cast Awe" for free. Zombies take their turn on your turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 1d4 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).

~Reaping~.Effect:
Whenever a Worthy Enemy dies in combat, gain 0.05 Max Mana.
If YOU killed that Worthy Enemy, gain 0.2 instead.
~Reaping~.Notes: You can't spend Mana in fractions (usually).

<Divine Transposition>.Effect: Swap places with your companion, then cast Awe on both of you.

Manual Extras: +1 in a Stat of choice (up to +4)
<Stat Bonus 4>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +4.

<Double Stat Bonus>.Effect: Gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +3, twice.

<Ascendance>.Effect:
Your Awe has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
You gain Wingspan (Cleric) and Penitence.
You start every Adventure with one extra Inspiration Point.

~Wingspan (Cleric)~.Effect: Quickly fly up to 3 meters. If you're in Worthy Combat, also cast Awe.

~Penitence~.Effect:
Make a Check with any Stat against a Unit's Sense Check.
If you pass, it can't cast healing Spells, do Crowd Control or apply On-Roll Effects for 1 minute.
~Penitence~.Notes: Against Epic Monsters, it only last for 2 turns.

~Everlasting Sustenance~.Effect:
You stop the effects of aging on yourself and your companion.
Your companion Levels Up.

~The Clerical Trinity~.Effect:
You have a third Unit beside you that you control, which is another Hero.
Your companion is built like a normal Level 1 Hero, but all its stats are decreased by 1, starts with no separate Gold and can not gain Feats.
It always has the same initiative as you and Levels Up only when you Level Up.

Apply the same "soul bond death" rules as your chosen Soulwright Ability at Level 2, and apply the same bonuses to the Stats (or resistances).
~The Clerical Trinity~.Upgrade: For the Quest Masters, note that this companion also counts as a normal Hero for encounter Experience!
~The Clerical Trinity~.Notes:
Come up with a story about why you have your companion and why your god allowed this or gave them to you.
You should now have 3 characters of Levels 1, 3 and 5.

~Encode Thoughts~.Effect:
You pull a String of Memory or Thoughts (can be visual, auditive, sensory and olphactive) from your own memory.
This String can be up to 1 minute in length.
To view the String, a person can willingly absorb it through the mouth, eyes, nose, etc (corresponding to the type of memories) and visualize the String.
~Encode Thoughts~.Notes:
It is visible to the eye as a magical ribbon-like energy. You can transport this String like you would carry a normal 10x10x10 centimeter object.
The String disappears after being absorbed or if you make another String.

~Wraithwalk~.Effect:
You become spectral for 10 seconds (until the start of your next turn).
While spectral, you can move through walls, objects and Units, but not through floors and ceilings.
If the effect doesn't end in an empty space, you are instantly thrown to the nearest empty space and you take 3d4 Pulse Damage.

<Army of Death>.Effect:
All your summons and minions instantly transform into Death Ghouls.
They take their turns on your turn (if they haven't already).
Death Ghouls have 15 Health, 1 in all Stats, 7 meters speed and their attacks deal 1d10 Damage.

Monster.Name: Death Ghoul
Monster.Description: After 1 minute, it transforms back to how it was previously. If your companion ghoul dies, it transforms to how it previously was (with its old Health as well). If other minions ghouls die, they remain dead.

~Attack~.Effect: Melee attack a Unit for 1d10 Damage.

<Presence of Fear>.Effect:
All enemies within 5 meters must succeed a Sense Check against Your Health Regen or be Feared.
For each Enemy Feared, cast Awe (on anyone).

<Sanctuary>.Duration: Until the start of your next turn
<Sanctuary>.Effect:
Choose a 6x6 meter area. Cast Awe on all Units there.
No Enemy can willingly enter the area or attack Units inside the area.

<The Covenant>.Effect:
All your other Characters Level Up to Level 10.
Over time, all your Heroes start to resemble you (or your equiavalent if a different gender), gaining more and more of your features until they almost resemble you perfectly, with some small flaws.
Passively, gain +2 Sense and +25% base Max Health.

<High Benediction>.Effect:
You Level Up to Level 13. Another Hero belonging to a different player also Levels Up to Level 11.
Passively, gain +2 Charisma and +25% base Health Regen.

<Wrath of the Wight King>.Effect:
You channel your sacremental magic to raise an army of undead.
If there are at least 100 corpses within 100 meters of you, roll 7d20, otherwise roll only 5d20. You raise that many corpses or minions that will fight for you.
You can have up to 250 such minions active at a time, including the ones from Awe for Corpses.
Passively, gain +1 in all Stats.

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 1d4 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).

~Coming Down Swinging~.Effect:
You automatically find a chandelier, rope, banner, or hanging sign even if the room shouldn't logically have one.
Swing on it to reposition up to 4 meters away.

~Wink~.Effect:
Play a _blackcheck_ after you failed a Charisma Check that you had a chance at succeeding.
The Quest Master tells you the required number to pass.
Starting from your rolled Check result, you may roll 1d6 again and again, one after another, to try to get exactly the required number to succeed. If you go above that number, you fail.

~Daring Leap of Logic~.Effect:
The first time you want to perform a Stunt every Adventure, it has +50% effect (in addition to other bonuses), but only if it's really awesome.
You must commit to the first idea if the Stunt is approved by the Quest Master, even if it's not that awesome.
~Daring Leap of Logic~.Notes: Its awesomeness depends on the Quest Master.

~I Know This Guy~.Effect:
Use when in a town or hub to add 1d4 to an Intelligence Check, to bring a reason as to why you know extra information about a particular domain because you encountered that subject, person or thing before on your adventures.
Come up with a story on why you are already familiar with that subject.

~Bravado~.Effect:
If your last 2 offensive Acts both either triggered a Critical Strike or a Combo, your next {Type} deals +{Amount}% Damage.
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Bravado~.Notes: This is not considered a Critical Strike. The extra Damage includes bonuses from War Craft and similar Abilities.

~Sharp End~.Effect: Your next weapon attack deals +1d4 Damage and triggers its Critical Strike and Combo effect anyway!
~Sharp End~.Upgrde: If it can not Critical Strike, it also deals +1d4 Damage and counts as a Critical Strike anyway.

~Hack and Slash~.Effect:
Your next {Effect}
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Hack and Slash~.Notes:
Roll the attack only once.
Weapon effects (like Critical Strikes), if necessary, are applied to the main target only.

Variants.Name: Hack and Slash
Variants.Effect: melee 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Slice and Dice
Variants.Effect: melee 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from you.

Variants.Name: Lock and Load
Variants.Effect: ranged 2-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target, but deals -50% Damage to them (deals normal Damage to the main target).

Variants.Name: Point and Shoot
Variants.Effect: ranged 1-handed weapon attack also hits all other Units 1 meter from the main target.

~Fame and Fortune~.Effect:
The next time you deal Damage, gain {Gold}Gold equal to 300% of the Damage dealt.

You also get Goldborn.

~Goldborn~.Effect: You can spend 300 {Gold}Gold to gain +2 Maximum Health, up to +10 total.
You can spend 300 {Gold}Gold to gain +2 Maximum Health, up to +10 total.

<Deflect>.Effect: Reduce the Damage of a weapon attack you receive by 100%.
<Deflect>.Notes: Works for ranged weapons. Melee body parts are considered weapons.

<Swing Thing>.Effect:
Use when a Unit within 6 meters (or yourself) becomes affected by Crowd Control.
Slam it 1d8 meters in any direction.
<Swing Thing>.Notes: Requires a Whiplash item, which can be bought for 50 gold (or freely crafted for the same price in materials).

~Overunder Blow~.Effect:
You have +1 Intelligence (up to your Stat Limit).
Instead of dealing extra Damage with Bravado, do one of the following:
SingleTable: 2. Single-Stun the target (Double-Stun for two-handed weapons)

<At Me!>.Effect:
After landing 2 non-Critical Strikes in a row on a Unit, inflict a random Crowd Control from the following options. Then the Unit becomes immune to ^At Me!^ for the rest of the Combat.
{Diamond} 1. Slow
{Diamond} 2. Blind
{Diamond} 3. Deafen
{Diamond} 4. Daze
<At Me!>.Upgrade: If they were both with a 2-handed weapon, the Crowd Control applied is doubled (Double-Slowed, Double-Blind, etc)!

~Strafe and Backpedal~.Effect: After you move 2 times on the same Turn, your next weapon attack triggers its Critical Strike regardless.

<Duel To Death>.Requirement: Only usable on Units with 50% or more Health
<Duel To Death>.Effect:
Challenge a non-Epic Worthy Enemy to a duel to the death!
The two of you take Turns one after another until one of you reaches 0 Health.
Neither of you can move away from eachother until the duel is over.
If you win, roll on the table to permanently improve your Hero!
<Duel To Death>.Notes: First, you continue your Turn; then the Enemy has its turn. After the duel is over, resume Turn order, as if you just finished your Turn. All of these Turns happen on the same Round, as if in a vaccuum (e.g. Round number does not increase for some effects' purposes).

<10 Percent Luck>.Effect: Once per attack or Ability, when you roll a 1 for a Damage or Healing die, you can reroll that die.

<Dashing Beauty>.Effect: Your first attack every Turn deals extra Damage equal to 50% of how many meters you moved this Round.

~Off-Hand Shank~.Effect: Make 3 attacks with a one-handed weapon you haven't used this Turn that would normally scale with a Stat. These attacks do not add any Stat to the Damage.
~Off-Hand Shank~.Notes: You may apply Sharp End, Bravado or similar effects to individual attacks.

<High Noon>.Requirement: Only usable on the 3rd Round of Combat
<High Noon>.Effect:
Make 6 attacks with a one-handed ranged weapon.
Further High Noon attacks on the same Unit (after the first) deal 50% less Damage.

<Exude Damage>.Effect: Your first melee attack every Turn deals Damage equal to your Movement Speed to all other Units within 1 meter of the main target.
<Exude Damage>.Notes: Excluding the main target and yourself.

~Renown~.Effect: Due to your deeds and radiating confidence, have an extra 10% discount on buying anything.

<Critical Ambush>.Effect: Your Ambushes deal +50% Damage instead of the regular bonus Damage.

<Minor Sudden Ambush>.Effect: Every Worthy Combat, your first weapon attack deals 1d6 + 1d8 extra Damage.

<Swashbuckle>.EffectGreen: When you get this, gain +1 in a Stat of choice, up to +5.

<Momentum Dance>.Effect: Gain Shielding equal to your 400% of your Initiative.

~Evoke~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Minor Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Minor Talents.

~Diverge~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target Ability or Attack targets an extra Unit in range per Evoke Point spend, dealing -50% Damage and Healing to the secondary targets.

~Overwhelm~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target Ability or Attack Single-Stuns the target per Evoke Point spent.

~Amplify~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next Ability or Attack has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type per Evoke Point spent.

~Obliterate~.Effect: {Evoke}: Your next single-target attack or Spell deals +1d6 Damage on cast, or +1d4 Healing on cast per Evoke Point spent.
~Obliterate~.Upgrade: These extra dice can not produce more Evoke Points.
~Obliterate~.Notes: If it heals, it does extra Healing. If it deals Damage, it deals extra Damage. If used with Damage over time effects, the extra Damage only happens when you cast the Spell.

~Transpose~.Effect: {Evoke}: Teleport up to 3 meters away per Evoke Point spent.

~Deathfire Wave~.Effect:
Shoot a bolt of deathly fire in a 1x10 meter line. All Units it touches take 1d4 + 1d6 + 1d8 Scourge or Fire Damage (your choice).

{Evoke}: When it hits a wall or the range ends, the bolt continues at an angle you choose for another 1x10 meters. This happens per Evoke Point spent.
~Deathfire Wave~.Notes: The bolt can't hit the same Unit twice. The bolt travels as if you're drawing multiple lines with the same stroke. For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, there will be 3 lines.

~Soul Drain~.Effect:
Deal 2d6 True Damage to 2 Units.
For each killed, heal for 4 Health or gain +1 Max Health permanently (your choice).

{Evoke}: Executes non-Epic Units at or below 10% of its Max Health per Evoke Point spent.
~Soul Drain~.Notes:
For example, if you spend 2 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 20% Health. If you spend 3 Evoke Points, this executes Units at or below 30% Health. And so on.
Both Units take Damage from the same roll.

~Veinlight~.Effect:
Choose a 3x3 meter area.
All Enemies in the area take 2d6 + 2d8 Damage of your chosen Element.

{Evoke}: Increase the area by 3 meters in both directions per Evoke Point spent.
~Veinlight~.Notes: For example, for 1 Evoke Point spent the area becomes 6x6 meters. For 2, it becomes 9x9 meters. And so on.

~Evoke Entropy~.Effect:
You start each Worthy Combat with 0 Evoke Points.
When you roll at least 1 ~minimum or~ maximum die on any Act, gain 1 Evoke Point.
Some Spells can consume all Evoke Points to gain an improved effect ^for each Evoke Point spent^.

Additionally, you have an extra Minor Talent tier for special Evocations.
~Evoke Entropy~.Notes: You must spend ^all^ EP when you decide to. You can pick one for free Evocation at Level 1, and get more like you would normally get extra Minor Talents.

~Borrowed Power~.Effect:
You each Adventure with 2 Evoke Points.
You age 12 times as rapidly.

~Blood Dividend~.Range: 5 meters from you to healed Unit
~Blood Dividend~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack or Spell deals -50% Damage, but heals another Unit for the Damage dealt.
Then it applies a ~Combo~ to one of them.

~Curse of Frailty~._Value: Baseline, 0, but can go up to 1 if used correctly
~Curse of Frailty~.Effect:
A Unit you can see takes +50% Damage the next time it takes Damage from an ally.

{Evoke}: +50% extra Damage per Evoke Point spent.

~Hail Torrent~.Effect:
Blast a Unit for ~2d10~ + ^target's Might^ Damage of your chosen Element.

{Evoke}: Hits an extra Unit (for ~1d10~ + ^that Unit's Might^) for each Evoke Point spend.
~Hail Torrent~.Notes: Each extra Unit hit must be different than the others.

~Invoke Kindred~.Effect:
Invoke 3 _Kindred Beings_, each within 10 meters from you. These are creatures themed and shaped to your chosen Power Source, which will do your bidding before returning to their original world.

{Evoke}: +1 summon per Evoke Point spent.

Monster.Name: Kindred Being
Monster.Description: Has a Half-Action. Takes its Turn at the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Damage of your chosen Element, or use an Item or Default Ability.

<Blood Pact>.Effect: This turn, all Damage you deal is increased by 50%. Every time you deal 10 or more Damage in one instance, take 5 Psychic Damage.
<Blood Pact>.Notes: The 50% increase is not applied to the 5 Psychic Damage.

<Higher Evoke>.Effect: You start each Combat with +1 Evoke Point.

~Overloading Evocation~.Effect: Cast 2 Evocation Talents you Know, combined, with the same Evoke Points.

~Aura of Ruin~.Requirement: Only usable the moment Combat starts
~Aura of Ruin~.Effect: Reduce the Max Health of all enemies by 10%.

~Translation~.Effect: You can understand any spoken or written language that's either Common (Dwarvish, Elvish) or Wild (spoken by "wild", tribal socities, such as Orcish, Goblan, Sylvan, etc).

~Decaying Blight~.Effect:
Channel to spawn a blight that spreads a 1x1 meter space away from a chosen space for each 1 Action channeled.
The blight kills small plants, insects and rots wood and rusts metal. It also makes fertile soil infertile, turns textile and paper materials into dust and decays food and poisons water.
You can channel a number of times (Actions) equal to your Level.
While within the Blight, you have +1 to all non-combat Rolls.
~Decaying Blight~.Notes:
You can choose to ommit some of the effects of this blight.
This Ability is not meant for combat.
Be creative with how you use this little Spell!

<Final Word>.Effect: When you have exactly 1 Mana, and you cast a Spell that cost 1 Mana, that Spell casts twice (for free).
<Final Word>.Notes: This is akin to casting the Spell again for 0 Actions without spending Mana (not necessarily on the same target).

<Manafold Power>.Effect: You have +1 Max Mana for each 3 points of Intelligence.

<Invoke Old God>.Effect:
You bring forth into the mortal realm a manifestation of your source of power - an old god from the `Pets and Animals page$/Other/PetsAndAnimals`.
You do not control it - it has its own Turn in combat with a Setback of 1d4 and possesses its own will. What will you compromise to forcefully drag an unknowable entity into the mortal plane?
Also, passively, you gain +2 Intelligence and Sense, and you automatically pass all Impossible Intelligence Checks (requiring at least 25).

<The Dark Ritual>.Effect:
Spend any amount of Mana. Your next Spell has +50% Damage, Healing, area diameter and range for each Mana spent.
After that, restore all your Mana.

~Command - March~.Effect: Choose a direction. All Allies (including you) may move up to 3 meters in that direction.

~Break Mountains~.Effect: Pick up an object up to 2x2x2 meters in size, and throw it 3d10 meters in any direction. If it hits a Unit, it takes Damage equal to the number of meters left (e.g. similar to Slamming)
~Break Mountains~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Break Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Takeback~.Effect: Deal 1d4 Damage to a Unit and Single-Stun it. Then end your Turn.

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Minor Talent that costs 1 Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body, weapons, or tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

~Command - Patience~.Effect: A different Unit you can see gains a number of 1d8 Shieldings equal to the Round Number.

<Quick Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Taunt a Unit you can see (that can see you)
<Quick Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then melee Attack a target on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in the straight line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.

~Colossal Strikes~.Effect:
Each _consecutive_ {Type} weapon attack or single-target Ability on the same Unit deals {Amount} to both you and the target for each previous consecutive attack you made on that Unit.
~Click on the Icon to select a preferred effect!~
~Colossal Strikes~.Notes:
Consecutive attacks mean that you haven't attacked another target. For example, say you attack a Goblin this Turn. Then you attack it again, and this attack deals +1d4 to you and the Goblin. Next Turn, you attack the Goblin again and deal +2d4 Damage, to you and it. If you now attack a different target, that consecutiveness resets back to baseline (no extra Damage). Even if you attack the Goblin again, you have to repeat the cycle.
Moving or using non-single-target Abilities does _not_ break the consecutiveness.

~Weaponmaster~.Effect: If your {Type} weapon can't Critical Strike, it gains the following effect.
~Weaponmaster~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal {Amount} Damage.

<Glory Run>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, a Glory Point appears directly behind the furthermost Enemy from you.
The first time you reach the Glory Point, heal for 1d10.
<Glory Run>.Notes: The Glory Point is just a space/zone.

<Overthrow>.Effect: When you Slam a Unit into a Wall, it becomes Single-Stunned.

~Lead Commander~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Lead Commander~.Effect: Whenever you use a Command Ability, give yourself or an affected Unit one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.

~Crafts of War~.Effect: Get one more different War Craft.

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
Choose ^TWO^ Basic Abilities from the Elemental, Nature or Eldritch Schools that cost 1 Mana.
You can use each of those Abilities once per Adventure (without spending Mana).
See the Level 5 Talent _Might Over Magic_.

~Command - Focus Fire~.Effect: Choose a target. Command all Allies (except you) in your party to make a Half-Action Act on the chosen target.
~Command - Focus Fire~.Upgrade: Can affect up to 5 Allies. If there are only 2 or less Allies, you also make the Half-Action.

~Move Mountains~.Effect: Pick up an object up to 2x2x2 meters in size, and throw it ~3d12~ meters in any direction. If it hits a Unit, it takes Damage equal to the number of meters left (e.g. similar to Slamming)
~Move Mountains~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Move Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.

<Into the Fray>.Effect:
When combat starts, determine which side is your Allied Side and which is the Enemy Side of the battlefield. Each side has a direction (Allied Direction and Enemy Direction).
If you end your turn more to the Allied Direction than you started, you gain one Shielding that can block 4 Damage until the start of your next turn.
If you end your turn more to the Enemy Direction than you started, your first attack next turn deals 1d6 extra Damage.

<Ruining Throw>.Effect:
Throw a weapon at a target and attack it (without Throwing penalties and ignoring Cover).
Before applying the Damage, the attack destroys all Shielding and Defense on the target and removes all buffs on it.
The target can't trigger "on roll", can't gain Shielding and can't benefit from Buffs until they spend an Action to recover.
<Ruining Throw>.Upgrade: Epic Monsters gain ther Defense back when they spend the Action to recover.
<Ruining Throw>.Downside: TODO - Make this more interesting. Also it has an _Upgrade_ that makes the weapon return.
<Ruining Throw>.Notes:
Your weapon lands at the nearest space to the target (and you should probably pick it up with a Half-Action).
"On roll" refers to effects like "if it rolls 10 on a d10, the attack deals 1d10 extra Damage".
Buffs are all effects that improve the target; even passive effects like auras or passive stats from abilities are negated.
You don't need Training in Throwning and this attack counts as a regular melee attack.

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.

<Attack Command>.Effect:
An ally immediately makes an Act that takes 1 Action (can spend Mana, Cooldowns, etc on it, as if it were on its turn).
You can use this at any point, before or after someone does an Act.
^You^ roll all the dice for this Act.

<Perfect Strike>.Effect:
Your next weapon attack this turn deals +300% Damage. If it kills the target, overkill Damage is dealt to all enemies within 3 meters of the main target.
Also, passively, you gain +2 Dexterity and you are immune to monster _weapon effects_ (e.g. critical strikes).

<Master Tactician>.Effect:
Gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks for every 3 sessions the Campaign has progressed.
From now on, at the end of every session, gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks.
Also, passively, gain +2 Intelligence and you know the Abilities and strategies of all enemies you encounter.

<Greatwielder>.Effect:
You can wield 2-Handed weapons, one in each hand.
Attacks like this take only a Half-Action and count as 1-Handed weapon attacks but deal -2 Damage.
While dual wielding 2-Handed weapons, if any Ability tells you to perform an attack with a 2-Handed and the ability costs 1 Action, it costs only Half-Action.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might and +1 Dexterity.
<Greatwielder>.Notes: If you already have a Technique Feat, you can remove it to refund the cost.

~Hex Magic~.Effect:
After you cast a Spell, you can expend 5 Health to force it to _echo_.
You can expend 3 Health to add or subtract 1d6 from any other Unit's roll (not yours).
~Hex Magic~.Notes:
The QM might not roll Damage for monsters, and instead take the average - even if they take the average, that counts as a roll.
Keep in mind you only have 1 Reaction per Round.

~Day Night Cycle~.Effect:
You are always in either {Orange('Solar')} or {Purple('Lunar')} stance, based on the _period of day_ (see gray text).

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: you have +3 Health Regen and can cast any Ability Shapeshifted.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: once per attack/Ability/animal feature, when you roll maximum on a die, roll one more.
~Day Night Cycle~.Notes:
{Orange('Solar Stance')} period is from 6:00 to 18:00. {Purple('Lunar Stance')} period is from 18:00 to 6:00.
Your stance may change during combat. {Orange('Solar Stance')} Health Regen applies if you end the combat in Solar Stance.
If the campaign setting somehow skewes the day/night cycle, the Quest Master should find a different criterion to determine day/night.

~Moonsun Fire~.Effect: {Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

~Venin Shot~.Effect:
A target takes 1d8 + ^Sense^ Poison Damage.
The _next time_ it takes damage from a weapon, it takes an extra 1d8 Poison Damage.
~Venin Shot~.Combo: The next time Damage happens now instead.

~Burnished Flames~.Effect: Deal 1d12 + ^Sense^ Damage (Fire if {Orange('Solar')}, Scourge if {Purple('Lunar')}) and apply a Combo.

~Curse of Locusts~.Effect:
A swarm of locusts appears and chases a Unit you can see for 1 minute.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Whenever it makes a Move Act, it takes 1d4 Poison Damage.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: For every Act not spent Moving, it takes 1d4 Acid Damage

~Effigy of Warding~.Cooldown: Up to 1 effigy placed at a time
~Effigy of Warding~.Effect:
Place an effigy in a space. It triggers an effect when a Unit comes within 2 meters of it:
If Enemy, it takes +50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
If Ally, it takes -50% Damage next time it takes Damage.
~Effigy of Warding~.Upgrade: Does not trigger if the Unit was already there.

~Solunar Psyche Blast~.Effect:
A Unit takes 3d6 Psychic Damage and:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: it becomes Blinded or Silenced (your choice).

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: An ally within 3 meters is healed for 50% of the Damage dealt.

~Improved Moonsun Fire~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Damage ~and Root~ an enemy for 1d4 + ^Any Stat^ (Fire), then Heal an ally for the same amount.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage ~and Single-Stun~ or Heal a Unit for ~2d4~ + ^Any Stat^ (Pulse) and apply a ~Combo~. The next ~Combo~ on that Unit triggers twice!

<Daybreak-Nightfall>.Effect: When you pass from day to night and viceversa, roll 1d4 and gain one of these boons.
SingleTable: 3. Your next Spell costs -1 Action Point

<Forced Eclipse>.Effect:
By weather-wight and star-song, I bid the sun forth and call the moon to reign!
Force 1 minute of artificial day or night in a 1km area around you.
<Forced Eclipse>.Upgrade: This can reset the Cooldown of Moonsun Fire's, once when it happens, and again when it ends.
<Forced Eclipse>.Notes: Nothing happens if used with Equinox.

~Love and Lust~.Effect:
At the end of the Adventure, if most of your time was spent in a certain stance this Adventure, gain a permanent bonus:

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Gain +2 Skill Points.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Gain an extra positive Quirk.
~Love and Lust~.Upgrade: These effects are permanent, even after you no longer have this Talent.

<Voodoo Magic>.Effect:
A Unit within 6 meters makes a Sense Check.
If it fails, it takes 2d6 Psychic Damage at the start of your every turn for 1 minute, and for its next turn, you can choose that enemy's Acts as long as it would seem reasonable to that enemy (decide with your QM).
Epic Monsters can not be controlled; they only take the Damage.
<Voodoo Magic>.Notes: For example, you can make a goblin run or recklessly attack one of your party members. But you can't make a guard jump off a cliff, because that's not what it would normally do.

<Corpseblast>.Effect:
Use the moment a Worthy Unit dies.
Explode the corpse, dealing 1d4 Poison Damage to all Units near it.
Heal for the Damage dealt.

<Blood Brew>.Effect:
You spend 10 minutes creating a strange splashable brew made from your own blood, with a random effect.
The brew can be splashed (Half-Action) onto a Unit (at 3 meters range).
When you create it, roll 1d4 to determine its effect.
You are immune to Blood Brews.
<Blood Brew>.Notes: The brews lose their effect at the end of the Adventure. Acid and Muck ignore real Cover.

Values: Target takes 1d8 Damage and becomes Blinded
Deals 1d12 Damage in a 5x5 area centered on the target, and a Toxic Gas cloud forms there.

<Bone Mass>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to the Health spent.
Sharp bones grow from the area (occupying 1x1 meters each).
When a Unit steps on a Sharp Bone, it directly takes 1d8 Pierce Damage and loses 1 meter of its remaining speed.
The bone then shatters.

<Star Fall>.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Heal a Unit for 6d12.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Damage a Unit for 6d10 True Damage.

~Eclipsis Penumbrae~.Effect: For 1 hour, you are both in {Orange('Solar Stance')} and {Purple('Lunar Stance')}. Both effects apply.

~Zodiac Alignment~.Effect:
Declare a 4x4 meter area.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Deal Fire Damage to all Units caught equal to the number of empty spaces in the area.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: Declare 1 animal feature. Shapeshift all Units caught into an animal with that feature for their next Turn.
~Zodiac Alignment~.Notes: The Damage is dealt all at once, not 1 by 1. Shapeshifted Units can not do their regular Abilities and can't cancel the effect. They remain Shapeshifted until the end of their (next) Turn.

~Consummation~.Effect:
{Orange('Solar Stance')}: Eat a non-Epic, Large or smaller Unit. While inside you, they are Blinded and Rooted to you and can only target you. {Color('red' 'Only usable while Shapeshifted')}.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You and a chosen Unit are bound in exile, banished together into the Celestial Veil until the end of their (next) Turn. It is Single-Stunned and Slowed. Your Turn ends immediately after casting this Spell.

You can only target each Unit Once / Combat.
~Consummation~.Notes: Whilst beneath the Celestial Veil, no hand nor spell may pass between banished ones and the waking world. Yet to mortal sight, those who walk the Celestial Realm are glimpsed faintly, as wraith-shadows drifting at the edge of vision.

~Primal Form~.Effect:
Your animal forms become improved and more akin to feral or primal animals, with larger fur, longer claws, thicker horns or even glowing eyes, depending on your stance.

{Orange('Solar Stance')}: You can pick one additional animal feature when Shapeshifting.

{Purple('Lunar Stance')}: You deal +1 Damage (from all source) and have +1 Movement Speed while Shapeshifted.

~Blessing of Yune~.Effect:
You weave a Blessing of Yune upon a willing ally whose spirit is clean and mind at ease, binding their soul to the turning of the sun and moon forever, while you have this Talent.

That ally now has the Day Night Cycle Ability, permanently.
~Blessing of Yune~.Notes: Once blessed, they are bound by celestial worship until death. Should they be reborn anew, you may bestow the blessing upon someone else.

<Sunrise/Moonfall>.Effect: Moonsun Fire now hits one extra target, deals 1d4 extra Damage and ignores Defense and Resistances.

<Equinox>.Effect: Your next Spell (this Turn or next) casts twice.
<Equinox>.Upgrade: If you use this with Shapeshift, you can combine into 2 animals, and have both their Abilities and their highest Stats.
<Equinox>.Notes: On the second cast, you can choose different targets, areas, etc (and it ignores Cooldown, Costs, etc).

<Dead Hands>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to the Health spent.
Undead hands appear in that area and make it Hard Terrain.
At the start of your next turn, summon a number of Draugr equal to half the Health spent, each wherever you choose in that area.

Monster.Name: Draugr
Monster.Description: Draugr take their turn the same time as you and you can command them to do move and attack. They can not do Default Moves or use items. Draugr last for 10 minutes or until killed.

~Attack~.Effect: Make a melee attack for 1d4 Scourge Damage.

<Schizophrenic Suggestion>.Effect:
Declare a square area with a diameter equal to ^twice the Health spent^.
All Units in that area must succeed a Sense Check agasint _twice the Health spent_ or instantly make an attack or offensive Ability of its choice, at full strength, on its closest ally.
<Schizophrenic Suggestion>.Notes: Monsters can use any of their Abilities that do Damage or Crowd Control, and target them however they want if they are Area Abilities, as long as it hits its closest ally.

<Bumboclaat!>.Effect:
Target a Unit.
The next time it would take Damage from any source before your next turn, the Damage is increased by 100%.
<Bumboclaat!>.Upgrade: You can only use this on targets that have blood.
<Bumboclaat!>.Notes: Applies to added extra Damage if it's the same type as the base Damage (e.g. Advanced Flank works, but not Smites).

~Portal~.Effect:
Start conjuring a portal at your location resembling the nature of your specialization and studies.
Think of an exact destination within 1000km.
At the end of the cast time, a portal opens at this location and the destination.
~Portal~.Notes:
At the end of the spell, the destination must be empty for the portal to appear there. Otherwise the portal spell is cancelled and goes on a 1 real hour Cooldown.
Stepping through one of the portals (obviously) teleports the Unit to the other portal.

~Barkskin~.Effect:
An ally you can see (or yourself) becomes Rooted in the ground.
While rooted, that Unit's Defense can't be lower than 5.
Lasts until that Unit moves from place.

~Spectral Hand~.Effect:
Conjure a _spectral hand_ in a space you can see.
You can control the hand as you move your normal hands. You can spend Half-Action to move it up to 5 meters.
You can cast Spells as if they originate from the _spectral hand_ instead of your own, calculating Range and Cover from it instead of you.
~Spectral Hand~.Notes:
The hand can't lift objects weighing more than you can lift just with one hand.
Moving the hand spends Action Points as if you made moved your own hand.
You can destroy the _hand_ at will.

~Grow or Shrink~.Effect:
A Unit or object you can see becomes one Size larger/smaller.
It gains or loses 10% Max Health, gains or loses 1 Damage on all offensive Acts, and gains or loses 1 Movement Speed.
Can stack multiple times.
~Grow or Shrink~.Notes:
Current Health changes with the Max Health (e.g. for 80/100 Health, if growing, new Health will be 90/110; if shrinking, new Health will be 70/90). When the effect expires, the new Current Health stays as it is, unless it's higher than the new Max Health.
When the effect expires, current Health remains the same if lower, or is cut to maximum if higher.
A larger Unit becomes 1 meter larger/smaller in both directions.
It's number of spaces occupied also changes with this.

<Shapeshift Fire>.Effect: Whenever you Shapeshift into an animal specific to the current time of day, cast Moonsun Fire for free, ignoring its Cooldown.
<Shapeshift Fire>.Notes: The chosen animal must be approved by the QM to trigger the free Moonsun Fire.

~Stunning~.Effect: Solar or Lunar - max die = heal or CC

<Pet Attack>.Effect:
The pet melee attacks a target.
The attack deals 1d6 Pierce of Slash Damage (your choice).

~Full Moon~.Effect: At the start of every Combat, if twilight, you have a 1/6 chance to be a full moon.

~Animal Feature~.Effect: You have any animal feature while not shapeshifted.

<Soulfire>.Effect:
Moonsun Fire has no Cooldown.
You become immune to Fire and Scourge Damage, and to being Blinded and Feared.
Passively, you always know the locations of any living Units within 15 meters, and you gain +2 Charisma.

<Be It Dawn or Dusk>.Effect:
When it breaks _day_, you heal for 50% of your Max Health.
When it breaks _twilight_, you recover 50% of your Max Mana.
Gain +1 Sense and Intelligence.

~Spell Book~.Effect: Replenish 1 Mana after each Worthy Combat.

~Magic Font~.Effect:
You may select a Magic Font to pick Minor Talents from.
You get a free Magic Font Minor Talent at Level 1.
~Magic Font~.Notes:
All Magic Font Abilities are Minor Talents.
You can get more Magic Font Minor Talents as if you're getting normal Minor Talents (e.g. a number of them equal to your Intellgience).

~Learn Scrolls~.Effect: If you have a Scroll that contains a Basic Ability (e.g. from Arcane, Nature, etc), you can destroy it to Know it permanently, without needing to learn it inbetween Adventures.
~Learn Scrolls~.Notes: You can not learn Class Abilities from Scrolls. Of course, you still need to spend Mana and respect the Cooldown of said Ability.

~Control Elements~.Notes:
{ElementNotes}
Apply common sense. The QM has the final word on whether something is possible.

Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Extinguish it

🔹 Roughly alter its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: A Unit that touches the fire takes 2 Damage.

Choose any of the following to do with it:
🔹 Move it up to 5 meters in any direction
🔹 Destroy it
🔹 Lower or increase its temperature down to near-freezing or near-boiling
🔹 Roughly its shape and/or color
Variants.ElementNotes: Water is Hard Terrain. A Unit that touches near-boiling or near-freezing water takes 2 Damage.

~Feather Fall~.Effect:
Up to 2 Units you choose will start falling gently, down to 3 meters per round.
Once the fall finishes, the spell effect ends.
~Feather Fall~.Notes:
Arcane Feathers can be bought in most towns.
For faster gameplay, you can spend 10 gold when casting the spell, and buy the feather later.

~Inscription~.Effect:
Cast a Spell onto a _scroll_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
The _scroll_ can be used with Half-Action, and is destroyed after being used.

~Attention~.Effect: Get one more Magic Font Talent.
~Attention~.Notes: You can have this Talent multiple times, from different Levels.

~Animated Weapon~.Effect:
Conjure a levitating, self-wielding melee weapon on a space within 3 meters.
It has 1 Action which can only be spent Move and attack,
It takes its Turn on at the same time as you, but disappears if it doesn't attack an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn.

~Attack~.Effect: Attack an Enemy for 2d8 Damage (Pierce, Slash or Smash).
~Attack~.Upgrade: If the weapon doesn't make an attack on an Enemy or Worthy Unit by the end of your Turn, it is unsummoned.

~Magic Rune~.Effect:
Magically draw a faint 3x3 meter _rune_ onto a flat surface.
Cast a Spell onto the _rune_, spending its Cost, Cooldown, Action Points, etc (plus the additional 1 {Mana}Mana for this Ability).
When an Enemy enters the _rune_, that Spell is automatically cast on that Unit (or centered on that Unit if it's an Area Ability). Then the _rune_ is destroyed.
~Magic Rune~.Notes: If the Spell has you choose something else, like a secondary target or an effect, you can do so the moment the rune explodes.

<Pyromancy>.Effect: Every Turn, after the first time you deal Damage to 2 or more Enemies with the same Ability, increase all Fire Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.

<Electromancy>.Effect: After the first time you affect an Ally with a Spell each Turn, increase all Healing and Shock Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the Combat.

<Arcanism>.Effect:
Your dice can't roll less than 0 (see below).
After every 5 rolled dice, increase that number by 1 this Combat.
<Arcanism>.Notes: The rolled dice carry on to the next Turn. This number can even exceed a die's highest number.

<Hydromancy>.Effect: Once per Turn, after you apply Crowd Control to an Enemy, increase all Cold Damage you deal by 1 for the rest of the combat.
<Hydromancy>.Notes: Hard Terrain does not count as Crowd Control. Slamming counts as Crowd Control.

~Upcast~.Effect: After you cast the next Spell this Turn, choose one of the rolled dice. Increase the result number of that die by 100%.
~Upcast~.Upgrade: This is not considered a Spell.

<Abjuration>.Effect:
Use when an ally (or you) would be hit by a missile (before hitting the target).
Fling it from air back to the attacker (with the exact Damage and effects).

<Animation>.Effect:
Whenever you spend Mana on a Spell that doesn't deal Damage, you can pick a Large or Medium object within 6 meters and bring it to life.
It has 3 Speed, can fly and can attack for 1d4 Smash, Slash or Pierce Damage.
Lasts 1 minute or until it takes Damage (after which it returns to its inanimate form).
<Animation>.Notes: Alternatively, it can use Sprint, Push or Taunt once.

<Illusionism>.Effect:
After you use Magic Mastery, choose an ally.
Create a clone of them on a space within 2 meters of them, and teleport the ally 2 meters in any direction (as to create a diversion).
The clone has the same Health and other stats, but takes 300% of the Damage it takes.
The clone can pretend to do anything the ally can do. If it attacks with a weapon or Spell, it can do at most 1 Psychic Damage per attack Act.
<Illusionism>.Upgrade: An enemy can't tell which Unit is real and which is the clone until the clone does something relevant and the Unit has at least 3 Intelligence.
<Illusionism>.Notes: E.g. the clone could cast Magic Missiles, but only one missile will deal 1 Damage (you can choose which, and apply Cover, Defense and other penalties normally - e.g. 1 Damage with Cover becomes 0 Damage). Alternatively, for example, it could attack twice with a one-handed weapon for 1 Damage each.

<Spellcraft>.Effect:
When you cast a spell, you can apply this any of the following effects to it:
{Diamond} For every 2 dice in its Damage, roll 1 more
{Diamond} Increase it or decrease its Area by 50% (if AoE)
{Diamond} Change its Damage type to any type
{Diamond} Increase its Stunning by 1 tier
{Diamond} Double its range
You can spend 1 {Mana}Mana to cast this ignoring its Cooldown.

~Amplification~.Effect:
Choose a Unit to amplify their magic potential.
Their first Healing or Spell Damage every Turn has its ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
~Amplification~.Notes: Doesn't stack with itself multiple times. "{DiceUpgrade}"

~Invisibility~.Effect:
Use on your Turn, or before a Unit wants to do something.
Choose a Unit you can see. It becomes invisible for up to 1 minute, or until it does an offensive Act.
~Invisibility~.Upgrade: You can spend extra {Mana}Mana to extend the duration of this by that many minutes.

~Polymorph~.Effect:
Choose a Unit. It becomes shapeshifted into an animal you choose until the end of its next Turn, which has 2 of the Druid Shapeshift animal features (also listed here).
It can not do any of its normal attacks or Abilities or use items, and all its Movement works as if it's moving through Hard Terrain.
It keeps its Stats, Passives and can do Animal Attack.
~Polymorph~.Upgrade: Apply all other rules for Druid's Shapeshift Ability.

~Animal Attack~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you roll maximum, apply a Combo.

SpellTable.Effect: When Shapeshifting, gain 3 Shieldings that block 1d4 Damage each. You are Long (2x1 meters) and Ridable.

SpellTable.Effect: Your animal features listed here have their Dice Upgraded to the next die type.

SpellTable.Effect: All Units within 2 meters take 2d4 + Your Highest Stat (any type). If only one Unit is hit, +50% Damage and apply a Combo.

{Combo} and a one Unit 2 meter from you.
