~Levitate~.Effect:
First, roll 2d100. That's how many kilograms you can levitate when you cast this.
Levitate one object or Unit you can see and move it as you like as long as it is and remains within 10 meters of you.
On each of your Turns, you can spend 1 Action to keep the Object levitated or move it again. Otherwise, it falls slowly and the Spell ends.
~Levitate~.Upgrade:
A levitated Unit is Slowed perpetually.
At Level 8, the amount increases to 5d100.
~Levitate~.Notes: Lasts until you don't spend 1 Action, or you become at least Single-Stunned.

~Major Illusion~.Effect:
You create an illusion that fits at most in a 3x3x3 meter area.
The illusion appears real to the eyes, ears and by smell, but physical interaction makes it obvious it's an illusion and objects pass through it normally.
The illusion can deal no Damage or Crowd Control, but can provide Cover or block Line of Sight (both from the front, and from behind).
On your Turn, you can spend 1 Action to keep and/or move the illusion, otherwise the Spell ends.
~Major Illusion~.Upgrade:
At Level 8, the illusion lasts indefinitely until you cancel it without needing to spend Actions, and it can hold its own simple movement and clockwork-like routines.
You can also program this illusion to react on its own in a specific way to specific triggers, but the instructions must be concise - talk with your QM about this.

~Conjuration~.Effect:
You can conjure an object that is up to 1x1x1 meter in size.
The object is solid and glows faintly.
You can't conjure mechanical objects.
The object disappears after 1 hour (24 hours at Level 8).

~Transmogrification~.Effect:
Touch 2 objects of the same type (e.g. 2 helmets, or 2 arrows, or 2 melee 1-Handed weapons, etc).
You make one of the look like the other.
The change is permanent until the object breaks.
~Transmogrification~.Notes: Upon close inspection of the shape and colors, this is visibly an illusion.

<Grand Wizardry>.Effect:
Spells that cost 3 or more Mana cost 1 less for you.
Basic Spells that cost Mana and have a Cooldown have no Cooldown for you.

<Destruction>.Effect: Whenever you deal Damage with a Spell that cost Mana, zap a Unit within 4 meters for ^your Intelligence^ Shock Damage.

<Evocation>.Effect:
Take the form of an _evoker_ - a being made of pure energy.
While in the _evoker_ form, all Damage you deal from all sources becomes Pulse Damage, and all your spells that cost 2 or more Mana now cost 1 less.
You can breathe underwater and fly at normal Speed.
<Evocation>.Notes: You can't end your turn inside an obstacle, and you can't move through walls, ceilings and floors.

<Graviturgy>.Duration: Until the start of your next turn
<Graviturgy>.Effect:
Choose a 5x5x5 meter cube.
That area become frozen in time - Units skip their turns and can't be daWizardd or affected by anything.
Any object that touches the area becomes frozen, too (and, if it is a missile, resumes its trajectory when the area ends).

<Hermeticism>.Effect:
You know all Basic Spells and they all cost 1 less Mana to cast. If they cost 0 Mana, they instead restore 1 Mana if used in Combat.
You may create your own _homebrew_ Spells as per the rules of _QM Resources, Homebrewing Abilities_.
You can use Restricted Abilities even if restricted in your current adventures.

<Highmancy>.Effect: Your chosen Level 3 Talent triggers 3 times when it happens. When using Magic Mastery on a Spell with the same element as your Level 3 Talent, it no longer gets its ^Dice Downgraded^.
<Highmancy>.Upgrade: All your other Spells become themed to the same element, but keep their original Damage Type. For example, if you chose fire, Frost Nova will now burst in cold, blue flames instead of ice.
<Highmancy>.Notes: For example, when you hit multiple Units with an Ability, you increase your Fire Damage by +3 instead of +1, or you gain +6 Cold Damage from Hydromancy when you Crowd Control an Enemy. For Eldritchianism, your Spells have their ^Dice Upgraded^ 3 times.

Combat Extras: You can jump 3 meters without requiring a Check
~Skipper~.Effect:
Your starting Stats distribution is 0, 0, 1, 1, 3 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2, 3).
You have +1 Movement Speed
You can jump 3 meters without requiring a Check (e.g. over enemies, gaps, etc).

~Tall Paws (or Hooves)~.Effect: You are immune to being Slowed.

~Carnivore~.Effect: Once inbetween Worthy Combats, you can eat a piece of meat to restore 1 Health.
~Carnivore~.Downside:
You can not eat grains and can only lightly eat vegetables.
Exclusive with Herbivore.
~Carnivore~.Notes: If you do, you take 1d4 Damage.

Extras: Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves, but you can not eat meat.
~Herbivore~.Effect:
Gain +2 Max Health.
Half of your meals can consist of grass and leaves.
~Herbivore~.Downside:
You can not eat meat.
Exclusive with Carnivore.
~Herbivore~.Notes: If you do, you take 1d4 Damage.

Combat Extras: -50% Slash Damage taken from behind while unarmored.
~Thick Shell~.Effect: While unarmored, you take -50% Slash Damage when hit from behind instead of having +1 Movement Speed.

Combat Extras: When you gain Shielding, give it +1
~Horns~.Effect:
Whenever you gain Shielding, increase its value by 1.
You have +2 in Intimidation.
~Horns~.Downside: You can't wear helmets (hats might fit you, though).

~Feral Claws~.EffectGreen:
Critical Strike - if you rolled minimum, apply a Combo.
Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum, the target becomes Blinded.

~Sharpen With Magic~.Effect:
Permanently sharpen your claws with a ^magic weapon^ worth at least 25 XP.
Increase the Damage of Feral Claws by +1.
The magic weapon is then destroyed.

Permanently sharpen your claws with a ^magic weapon^ worth at least 25 XP.
Increase the Damage of Feral Claws by +1.
The magic weapon is then destroyed.

~Avian Wings~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Avian Wings~.Upgrade: Your arms and hands become bird-like wings, but that makes it harder for you to hold and use weapons.

Combat Extras: -50% Smash Damage taken at 50% or more Health
~Thick Fur~.Effect:
You take -50% Cold Damage.
You take -50% Smash Damage while at 50% or more Health.

Combat Bonuses: You swim at your Movement Speed + 1 meter
~Fins~.Effect:
You have +0.5 Initiative.
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed + 1 meter.

Combat Extras: You can use Dexterity instead of Intelligence or Sense for weapons and Abilities
~Aerodynamic~.Effect:
In Abilities or weapons that use Intelligence or Sense, you can use your Dexterity instead.
You have +1 in Running and +1 in Stealth.
~Aerodynamic~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 12 + ^Dexterity^ instead of 12 + ^Sense^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + ^Dexterity + Dexterity^ instead of 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Sense^.

~All Eyes and Noses~.Effect: Whenever you fail a Charisma Check, you can spend 2 Health to reroll it.
~All Eyes and Noses~.Notes: You always know if you failed a Charisma Check.

~Eleff Nose~.Effect:
Once per Turn, you can use a Potion with 0 Actions.
You have +1 in Sleight of Hand and +1 in Smelling.

~Alignment~.Effect:
Determine the true personality alignment of your Hero. Choose if you are Evil, Neutral or Virtuous. Your other Abilities must reflect your alignment.
You can't consume cooked food. If you are Virtuous, you can eat only raw vegetables and plants; if you are Evil, you can eat only raw meat; if you are Neutral, you can eat either.
~Alignment~.Notes: The QM decides if your alignment has changed based on your actions and character development. If your alignment changes throughout the adventure, your traits will automatically change to reflect your alignment.

~Davel Stare~.Effect: A target becomes Fumbling if you are Virtuous, Blinded if you are Neutral or Feared if you are Evil.

~Davel Gift~.Effect:
If you are Virtuous, heal another target for 1d10 Health.
If you are Evil, Damage another target for 1d10 Psychic Damage.
If you are Neutral, another ally gains 1 Mana and 5 Shielding, which last up to 1 minute.
~Davel Gift~.Notes: You can't cast this on yourself.

~Demonic Ancestry~.Effect: In Abilities that use Charisma or Intelligence, you can use your Charisma instead.
~Demonic Ancestry~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 12 + ^Dexterity^ instead of 12 + ^Charisma^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Dexterity^ instead of 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Charisma^.

~Stubbornness~.Effect: You gain +1 in Might and Charisma Checks, and your alignment Abilities and traits can't change anymore and stay the same as they are now, even if your real alignment changes.
~Stubbornness~.Notes: That means you keep your Ability effect by alignment, food particularities, etc.

~Hellish Magic~.Effect:
You Know 2 Fire-themed Basic Abilities from any Ability List.
You can change these Abilities inbetween Adventures.
~Hellish Magic~.Notes: You still need to match the Level requirement, if any (e.g. Fireball requires Level 4).

~Slow Metabolism~.Effect:
Your lifespan increases by 50% and you can consume unlimited potions within 1 hour without overdosing.
When you drink a potion, its effect is delayed by up to 8 hours, then, at any point, you can instantly trigger the effect of the potion.
~Slow Metabolism~.Notes:
This is useful when consuming potions in combat, or when you need to quickly apply the effect of a potion.
This counts as if you consumed the potion when you use the 0 Actions, or when the 8 hours expire (e.g. for overdose).

~Wingspan~.Effect: Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).

Combat Extras: -50% Damage Taken from your chosen element.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Effect:
When creating your Hero, choose any element from Acid, Cold, Fire, Shock, Pulse, Poison and Scourge.
You take -50% Damage from that Damage type.
~Dragon Ancestry~.Notes: The color of your skin and scales as a Dragon should reflect the element you chose (e.g. Cold might be associated with white or blue Dragonswarne).

~Drake Breath~.Effect: Shoot a quick burst with your elemental breath at a Unit, dealing 1d12 Damage (of your Element Type).

~Dragon Breath~.Effect: Choose a 3x3 meter area. All Units there take 2d8 Damage (of your Element Type).
~Dragon Breath~.Notes: You can use this if you didn't use it last turn.

~Back Wings~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 6 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Back Wings~.Upgrade: You have membranous dragon-like wings growing from your back, which allow you to fly for short distances.

~Hulking Dracontaur~.Effect:
Your lower body is 4-legged, like a draconic-centaur, and your size is Long.
You have -2 Health Regen and -1 Dexterity, but +1 Might and, while Unarmored, you have +1 Defense instead of +1 Movement Speed.
You are Long and occupy a 2x1 meter area.

Combat Extras: Your armor needs to be fitted
~Primordial Dragon~.Effect:
You are Large and occupy a 2x2 meter area.
You have +1 Intelligence (up to +4) and +6 Max Health, but -1 Dexterity and -1 Charisma.
~Primordial Dragon~.Downside:
Body and legs armor must be fitted on you by paying 50% of its original cost.
You can wear belts as bracers, and bracers as rings.

~Wing Arms~.Effect:
Quickly fly up to 3 meters (e.g. almost instantly).
Passively, you don't take Falling Damage.
~Wing Arms~.Upgrade: Your arms and hands become wings, and your hands are more akin to talons.

~Second Skin~.Effect:
Choose one more Element from Dragon Ancestry
You take -50% Damage from that Damage type.

~Stouthearten~.Effect: You can wear an extra layer of Light or Medium armor over (or underneath) your armor. Apply all of its effects as normal.
~Stouthearten~.Notes: Unarmored is not an armor. 50% Damage reductions of the same type do not stack

~Forgeborn~.Effect:
Spend 1 hour at a forge while in a friendly town to craft an artisanal 2-handed weapon or an armor, that's made of metal.
Spend {Gold}Gold equal the item's base cost + 100.
If it's a 2-handed weapon, it deals +1 Damage. If it's an armor, its wearer has +2 Max Health.
~Forgeborn~.Upgrade: For example, you can't craft padded armor, robes, leather armor, etc.
~Forgeborn~.Notes: Smelting, forging, and crafting - must-know skills for many dwarves. It is not just a mere rumor that many of the best blacksmiths are dwarves, or have been born and raised in Forgeborn dwarf societies.

~Uldran Ancestry~.Effect:
You can spend 12 hours sleeping to recover 1d6 Health.

Also, you can choose to hibernate for 48 hours to cure all your minor diseases and poisons.
~Uldran Ancestry~.Upgrade: Loud noises and movement still wake you up as they normally would.
~Uldran Ancestry~.Notes: The nordic dwarves have made hibernation a core skill to surviving the harsh winters of the mountains.

~Shoreraider~.Effect:
When defeating people, your team loots +10% {Gold}Gold and goods like gems, metals, textiles, etc.
You have +1 in Boating and Swimming.
~Shoreraider~.Notes: Long boats, wooden homes and raiding parties are the common sight you grew up with, and you have learned much about these crafts throughout the years, for better or worse...

~Stonekin~.Effect: Use when you or an ally takes Damage that would make them fallen. That Damage is reduced by 100%.
~Stonekin~.Notes: Certain subspecies of dwarves come from Stonekin clans, and are fit for roles of leadership due to their thick, almost stone-like textured skin and temper.

~Rúndottir~.Effect:
You can inscribe one extra Rune onto weapons.
You can inscribe one Elemental, Intelligence or Sense Rune onto gloves. All Spells gain the Rune's effect when cast wearing these gloves, if possible.
If it makes sense, you can also inscribe other more powerful Runes (Magic Items) onto gloves.
~Rúndottir~.Upgrade: Only one Rune can be inscribed onto gloves.
~Rúndottir~.Notes: Some dwarven communities rely on runes for protection, enchantment and utility. Many of their buildings are laid out on key coordinates representing numbers or conceprs with strong meanings, and their clothes are often woven in the shape of constelations for good fortune and increased control over magic.

~Irontouched~.Effect: You have -1 Movement Speed, but +1 Might.
~Irontouched~.Notes:
Your skin has a metal-like sheen to it, your beard and hair are thick like metal strings and your finger nails resemble gems the same color as your eyes. As you age, these become more and more valuable, even being made of gold and emeralds in your days of age.
Dwarves with Irontouched ancestries have learend to be wary of strangers and bandits, many of whom will not waste the chance to kill and sell Irontouched body parts for money.

~Landliving~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Druid Talents, up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.
~Landliving~.Notes: From more obscure and hidden dwellings around the world, the Landliving dwarves inhabit forests, hill-houses and sometimes swamps, and have learned to live off the land. However, some of them are said to innately wield nature magic, and they may be regarded as oddly special or particularly uncanny.

~Meditation~.Effect:
As an Elf, your sleep is more akin to meditation and you only need 4 hours of sleep per night.
Elves don't dream and can still hear and smell while sleeping, but at a lower responsiveness.

~Gene Diversity~.Effect: When creating your Hero, choose 3 Elf Talents from below.

~High Elf Ancestry~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Wizard Talents, no matter what Class you are.

Combat Extras: You can inscribe 1 extra Rune on swords, bows, spear
~Moon Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
Silence a Unit.
Also, passively, you can inscribe 1 extra Rune on any sword, bow or spear.

~Purebreed~.Effect: Destroy a Magic Item equipment piece to permanently gain its Magic Item properties.
~Purebreed~.Notes: E.g. you disenchant Gloves of Athletics to permanently gain Skilled in Athletics, or you disenchant Gloves of Eldritch Blast to permanently gain the power to cast Eldritch Blast with a Half-Action once per Adventure.

Combat Extras: You can use bows and arrows with Stat Limit
~Wood Elf Ancestry~.Effect:
You -1 Might, but +1 Movement Speed.
When using a Sword or Bow of any kind (except Sickle), you attack with your Stat Limit instead of that specific Stat.

~Dark Elf Ancestry~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Warlock Talents (ignoring the Evoke effects), up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.

~Aos Si Power~.Effect: Gain 1 Mana. You must spend it this Turn.
~Aos Si Power~.Upgrade: With fox ears, the tail of a squirrel or eyes of a cat, the Aos Si (pronounced Ees Shee) are a mythical type of elf with whimsical roots in the strange magic of the forest. The animal traits are said to resemble the personality of the Aos Si from birth, the animal features do not necessarily correspond to the parents'!

~Faey Heritage~.Effect: You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Druid Talents (ignoring the Domain bonuses), up to your Level, no matter what Class you are.

~Thimble Kin~.Effect: You have -1 Might, but +1 Dexterity (up to the Level Limit). You can move through spaces of enemy Units. You can climb and ride on the back of an ally and move with them on their turn (without them having a Speed penalty). You are Small.

~Mana Block~.Effect: A Unit within 3 meters becomes Silenced.
~Mana Block~.Downside: Only usable on Units with Charisma is lower than yours.
~Mana Block~.Notes: As such, you always know if a Unit's Charisma is lower than yours.

Combat Extras: You don't age from time, but age when depressed, anxious, angry, etc. You see more colors and your dreams are vivid.
You don't have a sense of taste.
~Inherited Tastes~.Effect:
As a Littlefolk, you don't age from the passing of time. {Color('#470018' "Instead, you age more rapidly when you are suffering emotionally")} (in periods when you're depressed, anxious, fearful, etc).

You don't have a {Color('#003e1f' "sense of taste, but your eyes perceive a broader spectrum of colors")} than other races, including ultraviolet and infrared.

Littlefolk' daydreams tend to be {Color('#2d3e00' "very vivid, almost as vivid as regular dreams at night")} or akin to hallucinations.

~Life of Wonder~.Effect:
You start with 2 different {Link('Positive Quirks' '/Other/Quirks')} of choice, and 2 chosen Phobias of Monsters of choice (e.g. Zoophobia, Anxiety Around Cadavers, etc).
The chosen Phobias must be according to your Hero's personality traits.

~Halffolk Luck~.Effect:
After another Unit you can see of you makes a roll, you can force them to reroll one die once and keep the new result.
Passively, you have +2 in Luck.
~Halffolk Luck~.Notes: You are small in stature but big in heart, with nimble fingers, warm cheeks, and an easy smile that draws friends and fortune alike. You take life lightly, but your courage and cleverness often shine brightest when others least expect it.

~Redcap~.Effect:
Transform a Negative Quirk into the Clumsy Negative Quirk. The Quest Master chooses the non-Combat Skill you get a minus in.
Passively, you age normally instead of aging from negative emotions, living up to 100 to 150 years.
~Redcap~.Upgrade: You can only use at the end of an Adventure, and must finish another 2 Adventures before you can use it again.
~Redcap~.Notes: Your kind is named for the blood-red caps you all wear not out of tradition, but because no one remembers you for anything else. Redcaps are the grumpy middle children of the smallfolk world: too mean to be gnomes, too lazy to be goblins, and too proud to admit either.

~Pixie Dust~.Effect:
Your first single-target attack at most 3 meters away each Adventure makes the target Blind.
You have +1 in Magic.
~Pixie Dust~.Notes: With glittering, pink-hued skin and a sneeze that sends a puff of shimmering dust into the air, you're living proof that the Fey still whispers into the mortal world. Some say you were born from starlight that fell into enchanted groves, others that you're the laughter of ancient fey spirits made flesh. Your dreams are even stranger, colors even more vivid and personality stronger.

~Garden Home~.Effect:
You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Druid Talents, no matter what Class you are.
You have +1 in Nature.
~Garden Home~.Notes: With rosy cheeks, a round nose, and an ever-dusty hat, you're a living charm of hearth and soil. Your kind was born from the earth's fondness for caretakers: guardians of roots, flowers, and forgotten corners of civilization. Your kind prefers living in ornate burrows with round doors, along cobblestone roads paved between mushrooms.

~Blueskin~.Effect:
You start with an additional Positive Quirk of your choice, that you don't have already.
You have +1 in Convincing and +1 in Empathy.
~Blueskin~.Notes: Born of ancient woodland magic, you stand no taller than a toadstool and wear the cheerful blues of your kin. Your kind thrives in harmony and craft, on teamwork and cooperation. There is loot awaiting in our adventures, but the true treasure is the friends we made along the way!

~Farsoulen Spirits~.Effect:
You and another Littlefolk party member were born as twins, and are said to be sprung off the same soul.
If both of you have this Talent, you both have the highest of both's baseline Health and Health Regen (without buffs and items).
Both of you start with an extra Hatred Positive Quirk and Phobia Negative Quirk (the same ones).
~Farsoulen Spirits~.Upgrade: The two of you are bound to eachother, and always know the direction of the other if separated. You feel eachother's joy and sorrow, no matter the distance.

~Kobold Reflex~.Effect:
The first time you would take Damage from a physical source each Adventure, you dodge the Damage and negate it (if it's dodge-able).
You get -1 Intelligence, but +1 Sense (up to your Level's Stat limit).
~Kobold Reflex~.Upgrade: You may dodge any Damage from a physical source that would make sense. You dodge the Damage, but if the attack had any other effects like Crowd Control, it is still applied.
~Kobold Reflex~.Notes:
You have traits from the wild Kobolds, a race of feral Bertle-like folks with animal features, albeit much more agressive and less intelligent.
Choose which animal's visual features you would like to have!

~Leprechauni~.Effect: As an olden secret technique of your kin, you have a special _cauldron_. Whenever your party finds or gains {Gold}Gold from exploring or quest rewards, your _cauldron_ generates extra {Gold}Gold equal to 10% of the found amount.
~Leprechauni~.Upgrade: The Cauldron must be planted in a safe space, and can only be moved once per real month.
~Leprechauni~.Notes: Said to descend from fey tricksters who once bartered luck for gold, your skin carries a faint golden sheen, and your eyes glint like minted coins. Your tribes are drawn to the new and shiny, and your presence seems to coax gold from the air itself, as if fortune enjoys your company.

~Dom Voyager~.Effect:
The first time you deal Damage to an Enemy each Adventure, it becomes Rooted.
You have +1 in Housekeeping and +1 in Cooking.
You also have the Camping Ability.
~Dom Voyager~.Notes: Dom Voyagers are gnomes with a touch of old household spirit in their blood. Sturdier and a little hairier than their kin, they have a homey presence and a knack for keeping spaces warm and welcoming.

~Camping~.Effect:
Setup camp, creating favorable conditions for your party for up to 8 in-game hours.
Units in the camp are protected from all bad weather and are immune to being poisoned by food.
Until the end of the Adventure, all Units who camped here are immune to Hard Terrain.

Combat Extras: You can see 5 meters in the dark
~Goblin Tendencies~.Effect:
The first time you attack with a weapon each Adventure, deal +1d6 Damage.
You can see in the dark up to 5 meters away.
~Goblin Tendencies~.Notes: Your skin carries a greenish hue that seems to reflect your restless nature. . Your teeth are sharp and uneven, made for biting into life as much as food. It's hard for you to sit still, ideas come in bursts, and random naps are key to a healthy way of living.

~Family of Gremlins~.Effect:
You have +1 Intelligence and +0.5 Initiative, but -1 Charisma.
You have +1 in Crafting and +2 in Lockpicking.
~Family of Gremlins~.Notes: Your skin carries a rough, teal-tinted hue. You're endlessly curious. Adrenaline is your constant companion, and boredom your greatest enemy.

~Of The Jee Tribes~.Effect:
The first time you use a Healing Spell each Adventure, it does +1d6 Healing.
You have +2 in Performing.
You are mute and can not speak.
~Of The Jee Tribes~.Notes: Born from the whispers of ancient mountains and the songs of forgotten winds where your ancestors worship strange gods, you bear the legacy of your Jee tribe through your round body and pale shiny skin. You sense the world in subtler ways: vibrations in the air, the warmth of life, the harmony of life... if only you had a way to tell your story.

~Backwards Feet~.Effect:
Move up to your Movement Speed.
Passively, you have +2 in Stealth.
~Backwards Feet~.Notes: Your legs bear the mark of a strange mutation that occured among your folk long ago: slightly taller than other Littlefolk and your legs bent backwards. You live by cunning and instinct, protector and trickster both.

~Burden of Passing~.Effect:
Your starting Stats are -2, -1, 0, 1, 1.
Your are always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be.
~Burden of Passing~.Upgrade: With your extra Level, you do gain Level Up bonuses for it, as normal.
~Burden of Passing~.Notes: e.g. if playing with Experience, even if you have gained enough Experience to be Level 3, you are Level 4, but still require Experience for Level 3 to 4 to Level up - and so on. If playing with milestone Levels, you are simply always always 1 Level higher than what you're supposed to be. Maximum Level is 10.

~Burning By Silver~.Effect:
You are a cursed individual. Your race can be any of the available ones for cosmetic purposes, but your curse makes your race's abilities inert, and only have what the Hollow race provides.
You take +50% Damage when hit by silver weapons.

~Vampirism~.Effect:
Your Health Regen is 0 and can not be increased by any other means, but you gain the Drain Blood Ability.
You start with 0 {Blood}Blood Points. You can spend them to acquire Vampirism Features.
~Vampirism~.Upgrade:
You can't use any Abilities while in sunlight or in someone's home if you were not invited, or within 1 meter of garlic, running water or holy symbols.
Your body does not age, but your mind does.
~Vampirism~.Notes: You have been touched by the ancient crimson thirst that feeds life through death. Your emotions sharpen unnaturally: love, rage, envy, despair. Your body no longer breathes, yet your heart beats faintly with stolen blood.

~Drain Blood~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Slash, Pierce or Scourge Damage to a Unit. Heal for the amount Damaged. Generate 1 {Blood}{Color('red' 'Blood Point')}.
~Drain Blood~.Upgrade: Does not work on Units without blood.

SpellTable.Name: Dark Vision {Blood}5
SpellTable.Effect: You can see clearly in the dark.

SpellTable.Name: Sanguine Pact {Blood}5
SpellTable.Effect: Whenever you defeat a Worthy Enemy, gain 2 Blood Points.

SpellTable.Name: Overcoming Light {Blood}5
SpellTable.Effect: You are no longer affected by sunlight.

SpellTable.Name: Improved Drain Blood {Blood}10
SpellTable.Effect: Increases Drain Blood Damage to 1d8.

SpellTable.Name: Vampire Immunity {Blood}15
SpellTable.Effect: You are immune to being Crippled and to mind control effects.

SpellTable.Name: Quick Drain Blood {Blood}20
SpellTable.Effect: Drain Blood can be used Twice / Turn.

SpellTable.Name: Power Channel {Blood}30
SpellTable.Effect: At the end of every Adventure, increase your current Blood Points by 10%.

SpellTable.Name: Bat Form {Blood}35 {Action}0 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / real hour
SpellTable.Effect: Transform into a bat for up to 1 minute. You can fly up to your normal Movement Speed.

SpellTable.Name: Misting {Blood}35 {Action}0 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / real hour
SpellTable.Effect: Briefly transform into a mist and quickly move up to 6 meters away.

SpellTable.Name: Charm {Blood}50 {Action}0 Action Points {Cooldown} Once / real hour
SpellTable.Effect: A Person you're talking to must roll a Sense Roll at least equal to your Charisma Roll. If it fails, you can control it on its next Turn.

SpellTable.Name: Flight {Blood}100
SpellTable.Effect: You can fly at your normal Movement Speed

SpellTable.Name: Vampire Lord {Blood}100
SpellTable.Effect: You get +1 in all Stats.

~Drain Blood~.Effect: Deal 1d6 Slash, Pierce or Scourge Damage to a Unit. Heal for the amount Damaged. Generate 1 {Blood}{Color('red' 'Blood Point')}.
~Drain Blood~.Upgrade: Does not work on Units without blood.

~Lycanthropy~.Effect: At the start of each Combat between 18:00 and 06:00 (night), you must make a Sense Roll at least 8 or transform into a lycanthrope for 1 minute.
~Lycanthropy~.Upgrade: On certain nights, out of Combat, you may transform regardless, for 1 minute or longer. Upon returning to your normal self, you might be disoriented or have trouble remembering what happened.
~Lycanthropy~.Notes: The moon is no longer a comfort to you, but a summon. Beneath its light, your bones ache and your breath grows hot with something feral. Rage gnaws at the edge of your thoughts and your senses sharpen to the point of pain.

~Werebeast~.Effect:
You have +1 Movement Speed and +2 to non-Combat Sense and Dexterity Rolls.
Whenever ^you^ defeat a Worthy Enemy, heal an ally you can see (or yourself) for 10% of their Max Health.
At the start of your Turn, make a free melee attack on a Unit near you for 1d6 + Might Damage. If you don't, you take the Damage instead.

You have +1 Movement Speed and +2 to non-Combat Sense and Dexterity Rolls.
Whenever ^you^ defeat a Worthy Enemy, heal an ally you can see (or yourself) for 10% of their Max Health.
At the start of your Turn, make a free melee attack on a Unit near you for 1d6 + Might Damage. If you don't, you take the Damage instead.

Extras: You can hold your breath for 1 hour
~Death Forsaken~.Effect:
You have a Shielding that can block up to 1d4 Damage. It replenishes at the start of each in-game day.

You are considered Undead. You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour. You don't need to eat food, but you do need water and sleep.
You have +1 in Survival.
~Death Forsaken~.Notes: You walk between the living and the dead, a soul stitched back into flesh for reasons unknown. Perhaps you were a warrior, a scholar, or a thief when death claimed you... or perhaps even you cannot even remember who you once were, you poor, weak soul...

~Curse of Gray Flesh~.Effect:
You have -1 Movement Speed and -0.5 Initiative, but +1 Might and +2 Max Health.
You are immune to being Blinded.
You have +1 in Control Emotions.
~Curse of Gray Flesh~.Notes: You are afflicted by a curse of petrification, a gray, stone-like hardening that creeps over your flesh like slow-rolling mist. Perhaps it came from the gaze of a basilisk, the spite of a powerful curse, or a hereditary disease that has haunted your family for generations. The curse spreads on your body. Who knows how long you have until you can no longer move...

~Stolen Soul~.Effect:
You know the locations of any living Units within 15 meters that are not obstructed by thick materials. One of them of your choice gets a Combo.

Passively, you are immune to being Silenced.
You have +2 in Empathy but -1 in Memory.
~Stolen Soul~.Notes: You are a husk. Your soul lies someplace else, but it's tethered to your body by a fragile, almost invisible thread. Sensations reach you only as echoes, distant and muted, and the spark of creativity or clarity has dimmed. The voice in your mind is faint, your thoughts feel hollow, and the vision that once guided you seems blurred or absent. Perhaps you know where your soul lingers, or perhaps it is lost beyond reach...

~Wendigo~.Effect:
Force a Unit that is not looking at you to run away from you, freely, at it Movement Speed. It gets a Combo.

Passively, you have +1 in Nature and +1 in Tracking, but -1 in Control Emotions.
~Wendigo~.Notes: You have become a monster, your body gaunt and bony, skin stretched tight over hunger-wracked bones. This transformation is the mark of deeds too cruel or desperate to forget, a reminder of the inhuman acts that bound you to this cursed form. Perhaps you seek redemption for what you have done, or perhaps you wander, powerless to resist your cravings for raw flesh.

~Touched by the Abyss~.Requirement: Requires being in a natural water source
~Touched by the Abyss~.Effect:
Heal for 1d8.

You have +2 in Swimming.
~Touched by the Abyss~.Notes: The deep has claimed you. And your flesh no longer belongs to the world of men. Scales ripple across your body like the black tides of forgotten trenches, and writhing tentacles curl on your wretched body. The abyss is constant. Seductive. _Maddening_, tugging you toward horrors that twist both body and soul in ways no mortal was meant to endure.

~From a Different World~.Effect:
You have access to Level 1 and Utility Sorcerer Talents (you don't get the regular bonuses of the Unstable Spark die, but you can choose your Magical Archetype).
You have +1 in Luck, but -2 in Understanding People.
~From a Different World~.Notes: You came from somewhere else, a place close enough to feel but too far to name. The air here tastes almost the same, the stars are nearly right, yet everything is slightly… off. Memories of it are fragments. The kingdoms were different, but you can't quite name them. People were different, but you're not sure how. How did you get here? Is there a way back? ^Should^ you go back?

~Blood Disease~.Effect:
Whenever you heal with your Health Regen, flip a coin. On heads, you heal for +50%. On tails, you heal for -50%.
You have +1 Health Regen.
You are immune to minor diseases.
~Blood Disease~.Downside: Potions and elixirs do not work on you.
~Blood Disease~.Notes: Your blood flows with an unnatural vitality, coursing more efficiently than it should and bolstering your immune system in ways ordinary medicine cannot. But it aches and twists in ways you do not fully understand, and the price it demands is as hidden as it is inevitable.

~Gazed the Old One~.Effect:
You have access to Level 1 Minor and Utility Warlock Talents (ignoring the Evoke effects).
You have +0.5 Initiative for each -1 Sense you have.
You have +1 in General Knowledge and the Fear of the Unknown Negative Quirk (Phobia).
~Gazed the Old One~.Notes: Your eyes have glimpsed what should never be seen, and something ancient now stirs within your mind. The knowledge is intoxicating, the insight uncanny, the quiet of the mind impossible. The Old One watches...

~Mark of the Beast~.Effect:
On the 3rd Round of Combat only, you have ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type on all physical Damage.
You have -1 Sense.
You have +1 in Nature, Animal Handling and Survival.
~Mark of the Beast~.Notes: You have been marked with a visible, ever-bleeding scar. Claws sharpen, senses heighten, and a restless hunger stirs whenever you grow angry or desperate. You feel closer to the wild than to humanity, as if part of you is always prowling, always watching.

~Pharaoh's Curse~.Effect:
At the start of every Combat, a random enemy becomes afflicted with a curse of locusts, and takes 1d4 Damage at the start of your every Turn.
Everywhere you go, you bring with you bad weather, pests, and bad luck.
Everyone within sight or hearing distance has -2 in Luck (including you).
~Pharaoh's Curse~.Notes: The moment your fingers brushed the surface of that unearthed relic, or set foot in that forbidden tomb, the curse took root within you. ests swarm at times, crawling across your skin like locusts that no one else can see, and misfortune clings even to those who oppose you. This is the wrath and magic of someone ancient, maybe of a king long dead.

~Haunted Idol~.Effect:
Activate the Vile Idol to do one of the following effects, within range.
{Diamond} Deal 1d12 Fire, Cold or Poison Damage to a Unit.
{Diamond} Slam a Unit 1d6 meters in any direction.
{Diamond} Give a Unit 1d6 Shielding for 1 minute.
{Diamond} Teleport up to 3 meters away.
After that, flip a coin. On heads, summon a Idol Ghost for the enemy party, within 3 meters of you. The Idol Ghost will try to chase and attack you, and is not considered a Worthy Enemy.
~Haunted Idol~.Notes: You discovered it in a forgotten corner, an object humming with power you can scarcely comprehend, but seemingly possessed by a strange entity. Those nearby feel it too, a chill crawling down the spine, and sometimes, you wonder if the power you wield is truly yours… or if something else pulls the strings.

Attack.EffectGreen: If you roll 4, the Unit gets -1 in a random non-Combat Skill.

~Disfigured~.Effect:
You have -1 Health Regen, but +3 Max Health.
You take -50% Acid Damage and are immune to being Crippled.
You have -2 in Convincing.
~Disfigured~.Notes: Your body bears shapes that unsettle the eye, fingers that grow at odd angles, sometimes too many, a spine that curves in ways no ordinary body should, or a face that refuses symmetry. Perhaps it is a curse, a mark placed by some malicious force, or perhaps you were simply born this way, a malformed form in a world that prizes normality.

~Hollowing Fire~.Effect:
Your first attack each Combat deals +1d4 Fire Damage to both you and the target(s).
You can turn any Damage you deal into Fire Damage.
~Hollowing Fire~.Downside: You can not wear armor or clothes made of flammable material.
~Hollowing Fire~.Notes: Flames course through your very veins, and your cracked, blackened skin scorches to the touch. The fire inside you cannot be contained. Burning fire spews from your body, setting flammable objects ablaze. You endure the pain. You have no other choice.

~The Cure~.Effect:
Some say your affliction can be cured. Perhaps it's your life purpose to find the remedy.
If you ever succeed in achieving remission, increase your 3 lowest Stats by 1 and remove the curse you have.

~Jack of all Trades~.Effect: You gain +1 in your lowest Stat and +2 Skill Points.

Combat Extras: You swim at normal Movement Speed
~Tideborn~.Effect:
You can swim at your normal Movement Speed.
You have +1 in Swimming, Boating and Fishing.

~Blue Blood~.Effect: You can choose +1 Minor or Utility Talent.

~Hunter-Gatherer~.Effect:
Whenever you and your party defeats a boss, gain +1 non-Combat Skill Point.
You have +1 in Harvesting.

~Pigmy~.Effect:
Distract an enemy so that it won't attack you with its next attack.
At the end of this Combat, you gain +10% of all the {Gold}Gold your party looted from this encounter (rounded down).

~Spiritually Aligned~.Effect: You are immune to being Silenced and Cursed, and have +2 in Mental Resilience.

~Fated~.Effect:
At the start of each Combat, a random Enemy gets a ~Combo~.
You have +2 in Luck.

~Genes of Olden Roots~.Effect: You gain +0.5 Initiative and you are immune to Exhaustion from lack of sleep.

~Diversity and Inclusion~.Effect: You get -2 Max Health. Choose a Race Talent from any other Race.

Combat Extras: When rolling Event, something good or bad might happen
~Augmented~.Effect:
You have +1 Max Health and +1 Health Regen, but -1 Charisma.
When rolling an Event (two equal numbers on the 2d6), something slightly good or bad might happen to your body. The higher the roll, the better.

~Human Vigilence~.Effect: Whenever you make a Check (before the roll), instead of rolling, you can automatically take the number 6 for the die (as if you rolled 6) for that Check.

~Ignorance Bliss~.Effect: In Abilities that use Sense, Intelligence or Charisma, you can use the number 3 instead.
~Ignorance Bliss~.Notes: E.g. Chilling Shout becomes 15 (12 + 3) instead of 12 + ^Charisma^. Phase Orb becomes 2d6 + 3 + 3 instead of 2d6 + ^Intelligence + Charisma^.

~Apex of Evolution~.Effect: Your starting Stats distribution is -2, -2, 3, 3, 3 (instead of -1, 0, 1, 2, 3).

~Trollskin~.Effect: You have +3 Health Regen, but -4 Max Health.
~Trollskin~.Upgrade: Your skin is akin to a troll's skin - rough and prone to blisters or acne, but regenerates much quicker than normal.

Combat Extras: You can use MIG instead of DEX, INT or SPI for weapons and abilities
~Greenskin Strength~.Effect: In Abilities or weapons that use Dexterity, Intelligence or Sense, you can use your Might instead.
~Greenskin Strength~.Upgrade: Your skin is a shade of green due to the stronger hormones and pigment flowing through your body, making your emotions more difficult to control.

~True Giant Ancestry~.Effect:
You have +4 Max Health, but -1 Charisma.
You are Large and occupy a 2x2 meter area.
~True Giant Ancestry~.Downside:
Body and legs armor must be fitted on you by paying 50% of its original cost.
You can wear belts as bracers, and bracers as rings.

~Cyclopian Eye~.Effect: Your first attack every Turn ignores Cover (if there is Cover).

Combat Extras: You can eat rocks, dirt and bark once per day
~Ogre Fat Tissue~.Effect:
You are immune to being Pushed and to Falling Damage.
One meal per day can consist of rocks, dirt and bark.
You have +2 in Survival.
~Ogre Fat Tissue~.Upgrade: As an ogre-blood who can metabolize various debris, fat tissue is important to you not only for social status, but also for survivability!

~Ettin Crests~.Effect: When you take 10 or more Damage from a melee attack, Single-Stun the attacker.

Combat Extras: -50% Slash Damage from the front while unarmored
~Stone Skin~.Effect: While unarmored, You take -50% Slash Damage when hit from the front instead of having +1 Movement Speed.

~Two Heads~.Effect:
You have +1 Intelligence (up to the Level Limit), but -1 Sense.

You have +2 in Observing Detail.
~Two Heads~.Upgrade: Having 2 heads often means having 2 opposite personalities with different skills, 2 mental headspaces and 2 names, but folklore says 2-headed giants have only one soul, as they have one body, one heart. Life as a two-header is tough, facing likely ridicule or ostracization. But chins up! Two heads think better than one, and contrary to popular belief, such giants seem to have even more thorough control over their body!
